    Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have experienced rapid progress in visual recognition tasks in recent years. Given their potential integration into many critical applications, it is important to understand the limitations of their visual perception. In this work, we study whether MLLMs can perceive small visual details as effectively as large ones when answering questions about images. We observe that their performance is very sensitive to the size of the visual subject of the question, and further show that this effect is in fact causal by conducting an intervention study. Next, we study the attention patterns of MLLMs when answering visual questions, and intriguingly find that they consistently know where to look, even when they provide the wrong answer. Based on these findings, we then propose training-free visual intervention methods that leverage the internal knowledge of any MLLM itself, in the form of attention and gradient maps, to enhance its perception of small visual details. We evaluate our proposed methods on two widely-used MLLMs and seven visual question answering benchmarks and show that they can significantly improve MLLMs' accuracy without requiring any training. Our results elucidate the risk of applying MLLMs to visual recognition tasks concerning small details and indicate that visual intervention using the model's internal state is a promising direction to mitigate this risk. Starting with the proper Bayesian approach of integrating out intermediate modalities, we show that directly comparing the representations of data from unpaired modalities can recover the same likelihood ratio. Our analysis builds on prior work on the geometry and probabilistic interpretation of contrastive representations, showing how these representations can answer many of the same inferences as probabilistic graphical models.     Jack Merullo, Noah A. Smith, Sarah Wiegreffe, Yanai Elazar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how pretraining frequency relates to linear representations of factual relations and shows those representations can predict training-data frequency, offering substantial evidence about representation formation and knowledge encoding. In-context learning is used as a correlate, but reasoning is not the focus.

    本文研究预训练频率与事实关系线性表征之间的关系，并表明这些表征能够预测训练数据频率，为表征形成和知识编码提供了有力证据。上下文学习在此作为相关指标使用，但推理并非本文重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Pretraining data has a direct impact on the behaviors and quality of language models (LMs), but we only understand the most basic principles of this relationship. While most work focuses on pretraining data's effect on downstream task behavior, we investigate its relationship to LM representations. Previous work has discovered that, in language models, some concepts are encoded "linearly" in the representations, but what factors cause these representations to form (or not)? We study the connection between pretraining data frequency and models' linear representations of factual relations (e.g., mapping France to Paris in a capital prediction task). We find evidence that the formation of linear representations is strongly connected to pretraining term frequencies; specifically for subject-relation-object fact triplets, both subject-object co-occurrence frequency and in-context learning accuracy for the relation are highly correlated with linear representations. This is the case across all phases of pretraining, i.e., it is not affected by the model's underlying capability. In OLMo-7B and GPT-J (6B), we discover that a linear representation consistently (but not exclusively) forms when the subjects and objects within a relation co-occur at least 1k and 2k times, respectively, regardless of when these occurrences happen during pretraining (and around 4k times for OLMo-1B). Finally, we train a regression model on measurements of linear representation quality in fully-trained LMs that can predict how often a term was seen in pretraining. Our model achieves low error even on inputs from a different model with a different pretraining dataset, providing a new method for estimating properties of the otherwise-unknown training data of closed-data models. We conclude that the strength of linear representations in LMs contains signal about the models' pretraining corpora that may provide new avenues for controlling and improving model behavior: particularly, manipulating the models' training data to meet specific frequency thresholds. We release our code to support future work.

    中文

    预训练数据会直接影响语言模型（LM）的行为和质量，但我们对这种关系的基本原理仍只了解得很有限。大多数工作关注预训练数据对下游任务行为的影响，而我们研究它与 LM 表征之间的关系。以往研究发现，在语言模型中，一些概念以“线性”方式编码在表征中，但是什么因素促使这些表征形成（或未能形成）？我们研究预训练数据频率与模型对事实关系的线性表征之间的联系（例如，在首都预测任务中将 France 映射到 Paris）。我们发现，有证据表明，线性表征的形成与预训练词项频率密切相关；具体而言，对于主语-关系-宾语事实三元组，主语与宾语的共现频率以及该关系的上下文学习准确率都与线性表征高度相关。这一现象贯穿预训练的所有阶段，也就是说，它不受模型底层能力的影响。在 OLMo-7B 和 GPT-J (6B) 中，我们发现，当某个关系中的主语和宾语分别至少共现 1k 次和 2k 次时，通常（但并非必然）会形成线性表征，而这些共现发生在预训练的哪个阶段并无影响（对于 OLMo-1B，阈值约为 4k 次）。最后，我们基于训练完成的 LM 的线性表征质量测量结果训练了一个回归模型，用于预测某个词项在预训练中出现过多少次。即使输入来自采用不同预训练数据集的另一种模型，我们的模型仍能达到较低的误差，为估计闭源数据模型中原本未知的训练数据属性提供了一种新方法。我们得出结论：LM 中线性表征的强度包含有关模型预训练语料库的信息，这或许能为控制和改进模型行为开辟新途径；尤其是可以调整模型的训练数据，使其达到特定频率阈值。我们发布代码以支持未来研究。

    Zeyuan Allen-Zhu, Yuanzhi Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures factual knowledge stored in language models and how training, architecture, quantization, sparsity, and data affect that capacity, offering transferable evidence about knowledge storage. This strongly informs knowledge mechanisms, though it does not analyze internal mechanisms directly; MoE and sparsity are factors in the study rather than its central contribution.

    本文测量语言模型所存储的事实知识，并研究训练、架构、量化、稀疏性和数据如何影响这种容量，为知识存储提供了可迁移的证据。这有力推动了对知识机制的理解，尽管并未直接分析内部机制；MoE 和稀疏性是研究中的影响因素，而非核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scaling laws describe the relationship between the size of language models and their capabilities. Unlike prior studies that evaluate a model's capability via loss or benchmarks, we estimate information-theoretically the number of knowledge \emph{bits} a model stores. We focus on factual knowledge represented as tuples, such as (USA, capital, Washington D.C.) from a Wikipedia page. Through multiple controlled datasets, we establish that language models can and only can store \emph{2 bits of knowledge per parameter, even when quantized to int8}, and such knowledge can be flexibly extracted for downstream applications. More broadly, we present 12 results on how (1) training duration, (2) model architecture, (3) quantization, (4) sparsity constraints such as MoE, and (5) data signal-to-noise ratio affect a model's knowledge storage capacity.

    中文

    缩放定律描述语言模型规模与其能力之间的关系。不同于以往通过损失或基准测试评估模型能力的研究，我们从信息论角度估计模型存储的知识_比特_数。我们关注以元组表示的事实知识，例如维基百科页面中的（USA，首都，Washington D.C.）。通过多个受控数据集，我们证实，语言模型每个参数只能存储_2 比特的知识，即使量化为 int8 时也是如此_，并且这类知识可以灵活提取，用于下游应用。 更广泛地说，我们给出 12 项结果，说明（1）训练时长、（2）模型架构、（3）量化、（4）MoE 等稀疏性约束，以及（5）数据的信噪比如何影响模型的知识存储容量。

    Sylber: Syllabic Embedding Representation of Speech from Raw Audio

    Sylber：从原始音频中提取的音节嵌入表示

    Cheol Jun Cho, Nicholas Lee, Akshat Gupta, Dhruv Agarwal, Ethan Chen, Alan Black, Gopala Anumanchipalli

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Sylber learns compact, syllabically structured speech representations and shows generalization to unseen languages, with evidence of categorical perception emerging in its embedding space. This substantially advances compositional representation and offers partial insight into representation geometry; efficiency is mainly a tokenization benefit, not a model-systems contribution.

    Sylber 学习紧凑且具有音节结构的语音表示，并展示了对未见语言的泛化能力，同时提供证据表明其嵌入空间会涌现类别感知。这显著推进了组合式表示，并部分增进了对表示几何的理解；其效率主要体现在 token 化上，而非模型系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Syllables are compositional units of spoken language that efficiently structure human speech perception and production. However, current neural speech representations lack such structure, resulting in dense token sequences that are costly to process. To bridge this gap, we propose a new model, Sylber, that produces speech representations with clean and robust syllabic structure. Specifically, we propose a self-supervised learning (SSL) framework that bootstraps syllabic embeddings by distilling from its own initial unsupervised syllabic segmentation. This results in a highly structured representation of speech features, offering three key benefits: 1) a fast, linear-time syllable segmentation algorithm, 2) efficient syllabic tokenization with an average of 4.27 tokens per second, and 3) novel phonological units suited for efficient spoken language modeling. Our proposed segmentation method is highly robust and generalizes to out-of-domain data and unseen languages without any tuning. By training token-to-speech generative models, fully intelligible speech can be reconstructed from Sylber tokens with a significantly lower bitrate than baseline SSL tokens. This suggests that our model effectively compresses speech into a compact sequence of tokens with minimal information loss. Lastly, we demonstrate that categorical perception—a linguistic phenomenon in speech perception—emerges naturally in Sylber, making the embedding space more categorical and sparse than previous speech features and thus supporting the high efficiency of our tokenization. Together, we present a novel SSL approach for representing speech as syllables, with significant potential for efficient speech tokenization and spoken language modeling.

    中文

    音节是口语的组合单元，能够高效组织人类的言语感知和产生。然而，当前神经语音表示缺乏这种结构，导致 token 序列密集且处理成本高。为弥补这一差距，我们提出新模型 Sylber，可生成具有清晰、稳健音节结构的语音表示。具体而言，我们提出一种自监督学习（SSL）框架，通过从模型自身初始的无监督音节分割中蒸馏，逐步构建音节嵌入。这会产生高度结构化的语音特征表示，带来三项主要优势：1）快速的线性时间音节分割算法；2）高效的音节 token 化，平均每秒 4.27 个 token；3）适用于高效口语语言建模的新型音系单元。我们提出的分割方法具有很强的稳健性，无需任何调优即可泛化到域外数据和未见过的语言。通过训练 token 到语音的生成模型，可以从 Sylber token 重建完全清晰可懂的语音，且比基线 SSL token 的比特率显著更低。这表明我们的模型能以极少的信息损失，将语音压缩为紧凑的 token 序列。最后，我们证明，类别感知这一语音感知中的语言学现象会在 Sylber 中自然涌现，使其嵌入空间相比以往语音特征更具类别性且更稀疏，从而支持高效的 token 化。总之，我们提出一种将语音表示为音节的新型 SSL 方法，在高效语音 token 化和口语语言建模方面潜力显著。

    Synergy Between Sufficient Changes and Sparse Mixing Procedure for Disentangled Representation Learning

    充分变化与稀疏混合过程在解耦表示学习中的协同作用

    Zijian Li, Shunxing Fan, Yujia Zheng, Ignavier Ng, Shaoan Xie, Guangyi Chen, Xinshuai Dong, Ruichu Cai, Kun Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops an identifiability theory for disentangled representations, showing how sparse mixing can compensate for limited auxiliary variation, and supports it with generative models and experiments. This is a substantial contribution to representation structure, but the abstract does not address internal mechanisms of trained AI models, composition, reasoning, or systems.

    本文提出解耦表示的可辨识性理论，说明稀疏混合如何弥补辅助变化有限的问题，并通过生成模型和实验提供支持。这对表示结构作出了实质贡献，但摘要没有涉及已训练 AI 模型的内部机制、组合、推理或系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Disentangled representation learning aims to uncover the latent variables underlying observed data, yet identifying these variables under mild assumptions remains challenging. Some methods rely on sufficient changes in the distribution of latent variables indicated by auxiliary variables, such as domain indices, but acquiring enough domains is often impractical. Alternative approaches exploit the structural sparsity assumption on mixing processes, but this constraint may not hold in practice. Interestingly, we find that these two seemingly unrelated assumptions can actually complement each other. Specifically, when conditioned on auxiliary variables, the sparse mixing process induces independence between latent and observed variables, which simplifies the mapping from estimated to true latent variables and hence compensates for deficiencies of auxiliary variables. Building on this insight, we propose an identifiability theory with less restrictive constraints regarding the auxiliary variables and the sparse mixing process, enhancing applicability to real-world scenarios. Additionally, we develop a generative model framework incorporating a domain encoding network and a sparse mixing constraint and provide two implementations based on variational autoencoders and generative adversarial networks. Experiment results on synthetic and real-world datasets support our theoretical results.

    中文

    解耦表示学习旨在揭示观测数据背后的潜变量，但即使在温和假设下，识别这些变量仍然具有挑战性。一些方法依赖辅助变量（例如域索引）所指示的潜变量分布充分变化，但实际中往往难以获得足够多的域。另一些方法则利用混合过程的结构稀疏性假设，但这一约束在实践中未必成立。有趣的是，我们发现这两个看似无关的假设实际上可以互补。具体而言，在以辅助变量为条件时，稀疏混合过程会使潜变量与观测变量相互独立，从而简化从估计潜变量到真实潜变量的映射，并弥补辅助变量不足的问题。基于这一发现，我们提出一种可辨识性理论，对辅助变量和稀疏混合过程的约束更宽松，从而增强其在真实场景中的适用性。此外，我们开发了一个生成模型框架，其中纳入域编码网络和稀疏混合约束，并给出基于变分自编码器和生成对抗网络的两种实现。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验结果支持了我们的理论结果。

    Natural Language Inference Improves Compositionality in Vision-Language Models

    自然语言推理提升视觉语言模型的组合性

    Paola Cascante-Bonilla, Yu Hou, Yang Trista Cao, Hal Daumé III, Rachel Rudinger

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CECE uses NLI-generated entailments and contradictions to create lexically varied training captions, improving VLM compositionality on image-text alignment benchmarks. This is a substantial compositional generalization contribution, while interpretability is reported as an outcome without a mechanistic analysis of representations.

    CECE 使用通过 NLI 生成的蕴含和矛盾来创建词汇多样的训练描述，从而提升 VLM 在图像文本对齐基准上的组合性。这是一项重要的组合泛化贡献；不过，可解释性仅作为一种结果报告，并未对表征进行机制层面的分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Compositional reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remains challenging as these models often struggle to relate objects, attributes, and spatial relationships. Recent methods aim to address these limitations by relying on the semantics of the textual description, using Large Language Models (LLMs) to break them down into subsets of questions and answers. However, these methods primarily operate on the surface level, failing to incorporate deeper lexical understanding while introducing incorrect assumptions generated by the LLM. In response to these issues, we present Caption Expansion with Contradictions and Entailments (CECE), a principled approach that leverages Natural Language Inference (NLI) to generate entailments and contradictions from a given premise. CECE produces lexically diverse sentences while maintaining their core meaning. Through extensive experiments, we show that CECE enhances interpretability and reduces overreliance on biased or superficial features. By balancing CECE along the original premise, we achieve significant improvements over previous methods without requiring additional fine-tuning, producing state-of-the-art results on benchmarks that score agreement with human judgments for image-text alignment, and achieving an increase in performance on Winoground of $+19.2\%$ (group score) and $+12.9\%$ on EqBen (group score) over the best prior work (finetuned with targeted data).

    中文

    视觉语言模型（VLM）的组合推理仍然具有挑战性，因为这类模型往往难以关联物体、属性和空间关系。近期方法试图依靠文本描述的语义来解决这些局限，使用大型语言模型（LLM）将描述拆解为若干组问答。然而，这些方法主要停留在表层，未能融入更深层的词汇理解，同时还会引入由 LLM 生成的不正确假设。为应对这些问题，我们提出带有矛盾与蕴含的描述扩展（CECE），这是一种基于自然语言推理（NLI）的原则性方法，可从给定前提生成蕴含和矛盾。CECE 能生成词汇多样的句子，同时保留其核心含义。通过大量实验，我们表明 CECE 提升了可解释性，并减少了对有偏或表层特征的过度依赖。通过使 CECE 与原始前提保持平衡，我们无需额外微调即可显著优于以往方法，在评估图像文本对齐与人类判断一致性的基准上取得当前最优结果，并在 Winoground 上将性能提升至$+19.2\%$（组得分），在 EqBen 上将性能提升至$+12.9\%$（组得分），超过了此前最佳方法（使用定向数据微调）。

    Implicit In-context Learning

    隐式上下文学习

    Zhuowei Li, Zihao Xu, Ligong Han, Yunhe Gao, Song Wen, Di Liu, Hao Wang, Dimitris N. Metaxas

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    I2CL compresses demonstrations into a context vector and injects it into residual-stream activations, with analysis of its internal mechanisms and task-similarity representations; this gives substantial insight into model representations, but not a central study of mechanistic circuits. Its transfer and inference-efficiency results are relevant to Systems, while task transfer alone provides limited evidence of compositional generalization and the abstract does not focus on reasoning.

    I2CL 将示例压缩成上下文向量，并将其注入残差流激活；对其内部机制和任务相似性表示的分析，为理解模型表示提供了大量见解，但并未把机制电路作为核心研究对象。其迁移和推理效率结果与系统领域相关；仅凭任务迁移，关于组合泛化的证据有限，而且摘要并未聚焦推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In-context Learning (ICL) empowers large language models (LLMs) to swiftly adapt to unseen tasks at inference-time by prefixing a few demonstration examples before queries. Despite its versatility, ICL incurs substantial computational and memory overheads compared to zero-shot learning and is sensitive to the selection and order of demonstration examples. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Implicit In-context Learning} (I2CL), an innovative paradigm that reduces the inference cost of ICL to that of zero-shot learning with minimal information loss. I2CL operates by first generating a condensed vector representation, namely a context vector, extracted from the demonstration examples. It then conducts an inference-time intervention through injecting a linear combination of the context vector and query activations back into the model’s residual streams. Empirical evaluation on nine real-world tasks across three model architectures demonstrates that I2CL achieves few-shot level performance at zero-shot inference cost, and it exhibits robustness against variations in demonstration examples. Furthermore, I2CL facilitates a novel representation of ``task-ids'', enhancing task similarity detection and fostering effective transfer learning. We also perform a comprehensive analysis and ablation study on I2CL, offering deeper insights into its internal mechanisms. Code is available at https://github.com/LzVv123456/I2CL.

    中文

    上下文学习（ICL）通过在查询前添加少量示例，使大型语言模型（LLM）能够在推理时快速适应未见过的任务。尽管 ICL 用途广泛，但与零样本学习相比，它会带来大量计算和内存开销，并且对示例的选择和顺序很敏感。在本文中，我们提出\textbf{隐式上下文学习}（I2CL），这是一种创新范式，能够在信息损失极少的情况下，将 ICL 的推理成本降至零样本学习的水平。I2CL 首先从示例中提取一个压缩的向量表示，即上下文向量。随后，它在推理时进行干预，将上下文向量与查询激活的线性组合重新注入模型的残差流。在三种模型架构上的九项现实任务中进行的实证评估表明，I2CL 以零样本推理成本达到少样本级别的性能，并且对示例变化具有稳健性。此外，I2CL 支持一种新颖的“task-ids”表示，增强了任务相似性检测能力，并促进有效的迁移学习。我们还对 I2CL 进行了全面分析和消融研究，从而更深入地了解其内部机制。代码见 https://github.com/LzVv123456/I2CL。

    NeurFlow: Interpreting Neural Networks through Neuron Groups and Functional Interactions

    NeurFlow：通过神经元组和功能交互解读神经网络

    Tue Minh Cao, Nhat Hoang-Xuan, Hieu Pham, Phi Le Nguyen, My T. Thai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NeurFlow groups neurons by functional relationships and builds cross-layer interaction circuits to explain internal network processes, a substantial interpretability contribution. Image debugging and concept labeling are demonstrations; the abstract does not describe compositional generalization, reasoning, or model-system organization.

    NeurFlow 按功能关系对神经元进行分组，并构建跨层交互电路来解释网络内部过程，在可解释性方面作出了重要贡献。图像调试和概念标注是对其用途的展示；摘要没有描述组合泛化、推理或模型系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Understanding the inner workings of neural networks is essential for enhancing model performance and interpretability. Current research predominantly focuses on examining the connection between individual neurons and the model's final predictions, which suffers from challenges in interpreting the internal workings of the model, particularly when neurons encode multiple unrelated features. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that transitions the focus from analyzing individual neurons to investigating groups of neurons, shifting the emphasis from neuron-output relationships to the functional interactions between neurons. Our automated framework, NeurFlow, first identifies core neurons and clusters them into groups based on shared functional relationships, enabling a more coherent and interpretable view of the network’s internal processes. This approach facilitates the construction of a hierarchical circuit representing neuron interactions across layers, thus improving interpretability while reducing computational costs. Our extensive empirical studies validate the fidelity of our proposed NeurFlow. Additionally, we showcase its utility in practical applications such as image debugging and automatic concept labeling, thereby highlighting its potential to advance the field of neural network explainability.

    中文

    理解神经网络的内部工作机制对于提升模型性能和可解释性至关重要。目前的研究主要关注单个神经元与模型最终预测之间的联系，但这种方法难以解读模型的内部工作机制，尤其是在神经元编码多个互不相关特征时。本文提出一种新框架，将关注重点从分析单个神经元转向研究神经元组，并将重点从神经元与输出之间的关系转移到神经元之间的功能交互。我们的自动化框架 NeurFlow 首先识别核心神经元，并根据共同的功能关系将它们聚类成组，从而对网络内部过程形成更连贯、易于解读的认识。该方法有助于构建分层电路，以表示跨层神经元之间的交互，从而在降低计算成本的同时提升可解释性。大量实证研究验证了 NeurFlow 的忠实度。此外，我们展示了它在图像调试和自动概念标注等实际应用中的用途，凸显了其推动神经网络可解释性领域发展的潜力。

    Enhancing Pre-trained Representation Classifiability can Boost its Interpretability

    增强预训练表示的可分类性可提升其可解释性

    Shufan Shen, Zhaobo Qi, Junshu Sun, Qingming Huang, Qi Tian, Shuhui Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes an information-loss-based score for visual representation interpretability and reports that interpretability and classifiability improve together, including through interpretability-oriented fine-tuning. This substantially studies representation structure and interpretability, though it does not identify internal mechanisms or circuits.

    本文提出一种基于信息损失的视觉表示可解释性评分，并报告可解释性和可分类性能够共同提升，包括通过面向可解释性的微调实现提升。这项工作深入研究了表示结构和可解释性，但并未识别内部机制或电路。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The visual representation of a pre-trained model prioritizes the classifiability on downstream tasks, while the widespread applications for pre-trained visual models have posed new requirements for representation interpretability. However, it remains unclear whether the pre-trained representations can achieve high interpretability and classifiability simultaneously. To answer this question, we quantify the representation interpretability by leveraging its correlation with the ratio of interpretable semantics within the representations. Given the pre-trained representations, only the interpretable semantics can be captured by interpretations, whereas the uninterpretable part leads to information loss. Based on this fact, we propose the Inherent Interpretability Score (IIS) that evaluates the information loss, measures the ratio of interpretable semantics, and quantifies the representation interpretability. In the evaluation of the representation interpretability with different classifiability, we surprisingly discover that the interpretability and classifiability are positively correlated, i.e., representations with higher classifiability provide more interpretable semantics that can be captured in the interpretations. This observation further supports two benefits to the pre-trained representations. First, the classifiability of representations can be further improved by fine-tuning with interpretability maximization. Second, with the classifiability improvement for the representations, we obtain predictions based on their interpretations with less accuracy degradation. The discovered positive correlation and corresponding applications show that practitioners can unify the improvements in interpretability and classifiability for pre-trained vision models. Codes are available at https://github.com/ssfgunner/IIS.

    中文

    预训练模型的视觉表示优先考虑下游任务中的可分类性，而预训练视觉模型的广泛应用也对表示的可解释性提出了新要求。然而，预训练表示能否同时具备高可解释性和高可分类性，仍不清楚。为回答这一问题，我们利用表示可解释性与表示中可解释语义占比之间的相关性，对表示可解释性进行量化。对于给定的预训练表示，只有可解释语义能够被解释结果捕捉，而不可解释部分会导致信息损失。基于这一事实，我们提出内在可解释性分数（IIS），用于评估信息损失、衡量可解释语义的占比，并量化表示的可解释性。在对可分类性不同的表示进行可解释性评估时，我们意外发现可解释性和可分类性呈正相关，也就是说，可分类性更高的表示能提供更多可被解释结果捕捉的可解释语义。这一观察进一步揭示了预训练表示的两项益处。第一，通过最大化可解释性的微调，可以进一步提高表示的可分类性。第二，随着表示可分类性的提高，我们可以基于其解释结果获得准确率下降更少的预测。所发现的正相关及相应应用表明，实践者可以统一提升预训练视觉模型的可解释性和可分类性。代码见 https://github.com/ssfgunner/IIS。

    QPM: Discrete Optimization for Globally Interpretable Image Classification

    QPM：用于全局可解释图像分类的离散优化

    Thomas Norrenbrock, Timo Kaiser, Sovan Biswas, Ramesh Manuvinakurike, Bodo Rosenhahn

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    QPM learns compact, shared class features and uses discrete optimization to produce global explanations of image classifier behavior, a substantial contribution to interpretable representations. The class-feature combinations are incidental to compositional generalization, and the abstract offers no substantive reasoning or systems contribution.

    QPM 学习紧凑且共享的类别特征，并利用离散优化生成图像分类器行为的全局解释，为可解释表征作出了重要贡献。类别与特征的组合对组合泛化而言只是附带内容，摘要也没有实质性讨论推理或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Understanding the classifications of deep neural networks, e.g. used in safety-critical situations, is becoming increasingly important. While recent models can locally explain a single decision, to provide a faithful global explanation about an accurate model’s general behavior is a more challenging open task. Towards that goal, we introduce the Quadratic Programming Enhanced Model (QPM), which learns globally interpretable class representations. QPM represents every class with a binary assignment of very few, typically 5, features, that are also assigned to other classes, ensuring easily comparable contrastive class representations. This compact binary assignment is found using discrete optimization based on predefined similarity measures and interpretability constraints. The resulting optimal assignment is used to fine-tune the diverse features, so that each of them becomes the shared general concept between the assigned classes. Extensive evaluations show that QPM delivers unprecedented global interpretability across small and large-scale datasets while setting the state of the art for the accuracy of interpretable models.

    中文

    理解深度神经网络的分类结果（例如在安全关键场景中使用的网络）正变得日益重要。尽管近期模型能够对单个决策进行局部解释，但要对准确模型的一般行为提供忠实的全局解释，仍是一项更具挑战性的开放任务。为此，我们提出二次规划增强模型（QPM），它能够学习全局可解释的类别表征。QPM 用极少的特征（通常为 5 个）的二元分配来表示每个类别，这些特征也会分配给其他类别，从而确保类别表征具有易于比较的对比性。通过基于预定义相似度度量和可解释性约束的离散优化，获得这种紧凑的二元分配。随后使用得到的最优分配对多样化特征进行微调，使每个特征都成为所分配类别之间共享的一般概念。大量评估表明，QPM 在大小规模数据集上实现了前所未有的全局可解释性，同时在可解释模型的准确率方面达到最先进水平。

    Geometry of Long-Tailed Representation Learning: Rebalancing Features for Skewed Distributions

    长尾表征学习的几何：为偏斜分布重新平衡特征

    Lingjie Yi, Jiachen Yao, Weimin Lyu, Haibin Ling, Raphael Douady, Chao Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how long-tailed data distort feature geometry, including conditions for tail-class center collapse, and proposes feature-space reconstruction. Its theoretical account of representation structure is a substantial contribution to representation geometry, but it does not address the other directions.

    本文分析了长尾数据如何扭曲特征几何结构，包括尾部类别中心塌缩的条件，并提出特征空间重构方法。它对表征结构的理论分析为表征几何作出了重要贡献，但没有涉及其他方向。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep learning has achieved significant success by training on balanced datasets. However, real-world data often exhibit long-tailed distributions. Empirical studies have revealed that long-tailed data skew data representations, where head classes dominate the feature space. Many methods have been proposed to empirically rectify the skewed representations. However, a clear understanding of the underlying cause and extent of this skew remains lacking. In this study, we provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis to elucidate how long-tailed data affect feature distributions, deriving the conditions under which centers of tail classes shrink together or even collapse into a single point. This results in overlapping feature distributions of tail classes, making features in the overlapping regions inseparable. Moreover, we demonstrate that merely empirically correcting the skewed representations of the training data is insufficient to separate the overlapping features due to distribution shifts between the training and real data. To address these challenges, we propose a novel long-tailed representation learning method, FeatRecon. It reconstructs the feature space in order to arrange features from different classes into symmetricial and linearly separable regions. This, in turn, enhances the model’s robustness to long-tailed data. We validate the effectiveness of our method through extensive experiments on the CIFAR-10-LT, CIFAR-100-LT, ImageNet-LT, and iNaturalist 2018 datasets.

    中文

    深度学习通过在平衡数据集上训练取得了显著成功。然而，现实世界的数据往往呈现长尾分布。实证研究发现，长尾数据会使数据表征发生偏斜，头部类别主导特征空间。人们已提出许多方法，试图通过经验手段纠正偏斜的表征。然而，对这种偏斜的根本原因和程度仍缺乏清晰认识。在本研究中，我们提供了全面的理论分析，以阐明长尾数据如何影响特征分布，并推导出尾部类别的中心彼此收缩、甚至塌缩到同一点的条件。这会导致尾部类别的特征分布重叠，使重叠区域中的特征无法分离。此外，我们证明，由于训练数据与真实数据之间存在分布偏移，仅通过经验手段纠正训练数据中偏斜的表征，并不足以分离这些重叠特征。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种新颖的长尾表征学习方法 FeatRecon。它通过重构特征空间，将不同类别的特征排列到对称且线性可分的区域中，进而增强模型对长尾数据的鲁棒性。我们在 CIFAR-10-LT、CIFAR-100-LT、ImageNet-LT 和 iNaturalist 2018 数据集上进行了大量实验，验证了该方法的有效性。

    Self-MoE: Towards Compositional Large Language Models with Self-Specialized Experts

    Self-MoE：通过自专化专家构建组合式大型语言模型

    Junmo Kang, Leonid Karlinsky, Hongyin Luo, Zhen Wang, Jacob A Hansen, James R. Glass, David Daniel Cox, Rameswar Panda, Rogerio Feris, Alan Ritter

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Self-MoE builds self-specialized experts with self-optimized routing, contributing a modular architecture for recombining capabilities across tasks. Its semantic experts offer an interpretability benefit, but the abstract does not describe internal representation or mechanism analysis; reasoning appears as a benchmark domain.

    Self-MoE 通过自优化路由构建自专化专家，为跨任务重组能力提供了一种模块化架构。其语义专家具有可解释性优势，但摘要没有描述内部表征或机制分析；推理只是一个基准领域。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We present Self-MoE, an approach that transforms a monolithic LLM into a compositional, modular system of self-specialized experts, named MiXSE (MiXture of Self-specialized Experts). Our approach leverages self-specialization, which constructs expert modules using self-generated synthetic data, each equipping a shared base LLM with distinct domain-specific capabilities, activated via self-optimized routing. This allows for dynamic and capability-specific handling of various target tasks, enhancing overall capabilities, without extensive human-labeled data and added parameters. Our empirical results reveal that specializing LLMs may exhibit potential trade-offs in performances on non-specialized tasks. On the other hand, our Self-MoE demonstrates substantial improvements (6.5%p on average) over the base LLM across diverse benchmarks such as knowledge, reasoning, math, and coding. It also consistently outperforms other methods, including instance merging and weight merging, while offering better flexibility and interpretability by design with semantic experts and routing. Our findings highlight the critical role of modularity, the applicability of Self-MoE to multiple base LLMs, and the potential of self-improvement in achieving efficient, scalable, and adaptable systems.

    中文

    我们提出 Self-MoE，这种方法可将单体 LLM 转化为由自专化专家构成的组合式模块化系统，称为 MiXSE（自专化专家混合）。我们的方法利用自专化机制，通过自生成的合成数据构建专家模块；每个模块都为共享的基础 LLM 配备不同的领域专属能力，并通过自优化路由激活。这使模型无需大量人工标注数据或增加参数，就能针对各种目标任务进行动态、按能力适配的处理，从而提升整体能力。我们的实证结果表明，专门化 LLM 在非专门化任务上的表现可能会有所取舍。另一方面，在知识、推理、数学和编程等多样化基准上，Self-MoE 相比基础 LLM 平均提升 6.5 个百分点。它也持续优于实例合并、权重合并等其他方法，并凭借语义专家和路由设计提供更好的灵活性与可解释性。我们的研究结果凸显了模块化的关键作用、Self-MoE 对多个基础 LLM 的适用性，以及自我改进在实现高效、可扩展且适应性强的系统方面的潜力。

    Multiplicative Logit Adjustment Approximates Neural-Collapse-Aware Decision Boundary Adjustment

    乘法式 Logit 调整近似于考虑神经坍塌的决策边界调整

    Naoya Hasegawa, Issei Sato

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives a neural-collapse-based adjustment to optimal decision boundaries and shows that multiplicative logit adjustment approximates it, offering theoretical insight into classifier behavior. The application is long-tailed recognition, with no substantive contribution to composition, reasoning, or model systems.

    本文推导了一种基于神经坍塌的最优决策边界调整方法，并证明乘法式 logit 调整近似于该方法，从而为分类器行为提供了理论见解。其应用是长尾识别，对组合性、推理或模型系统没有实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Real-world data distributions are often highly skewed. This has spurred a growing body of research on long-tailed recognition, aimed at addressing the imbalance in training classification models. Among the methods studied, multiplicative logit adjustment (MLA) stands out as a simple and effective method. What theoretical foundation explains the effectiveness of this heuristic method? We provide a justification for the effectiveness of MLA with the following two-step process. First, we develop a theory that adjusts optimal decision boundaries by estimating feature spread on the basis of neural collapse. Second, we demonstrate that MLA approximates this optimal method. Additionally, through experiments on long-tailed datasets, we illustrate the practical usefulness of MLA under more realistic conditions. We also offer experimental insights to guide the tuning of MLA hyperparameters.

    中文

    现实世界的数据分布往往高度偏斜。这推动了长尾识别研究的不断发展，旨在解决分类模型训练中的类别不平衡问题。在已研究的方法中，乘法式 logit 调整（MLA）作为一种简单有效的方法脱颖而出。是什么理论基础解释了这一启发式方法的有效性？ 我们通过以下两个步骤论证 MLA 的有效性。首先，我们基于神经坍塌，通过估计特征的离散程度，建立调整最优决策边界的理论。其次，我们证明 MLA 近似于这一最优方法。此外，我们通过在长尾数据集上的实验，展示 MLA 在更贴近现实的条件下的实用价值。我们还提供了实验方面的见解，以指导 MLA 超参数的调节。

    Can In-context Learning Really Generalize to Out-of-distribution Tasks?

    上下文学习真的能泛化到分布外任务吗？

    Qixun Wang, Yifei Wang, Xianghua Ying, Yisen Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how ICL handles OOD tasks and proposes a theoretical low-test-error preference to explain its behavior, giving substantial insight into a model mechanism. Its OOD generalization results touch on transfer and learning, but do not directly study compositionality or reasoning capabilities; systems design is incidental.

    本文分析 ICL 如何处理 OOD 任务，并提出低测试误差偏好的理论来解释其行为，为模型机制提供了实质性见解。其关于 OOD 泛化的结果涉及迁移与学习，但没有直接研究组合性或推理能力；系统设计只是次要内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In this work, we explore the mechanism of in-context learning (ICL) on out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks that were not encountered during training. To achieve this, we conduct synthetic experiments where the objective is to learn OOD mathematical functions through ICL using a GPT-2 model. We reveal that Transformers may struggle to learn OOD task functions through ICL. Specifically, ICL performance resembles implementing a function within the pretraining hypothesis space and optimizing it with gradient descent based on the in-context examples. Additionally, we investigate ICL's well-documented ability to learn unseen abstract labels in context. We demonstrate that such ability only manifests in the scenarios without distributional shifts and, therefore, may not serve as evidence of new-task-learning ability. Furthermore, we assess ICL's performance on OOD tasks when the model is pretrained on multiple tasks. Both empirical and theoretical analyses demonstrate the existence of the \textbf{low-test-error preference} of ICL, where it tends to implement the pretraining function that yields low test error in the testing context. We validate this through numerical experiments. This new theoretical result, combined with our empirical findings, elucidates the mechanism of ICL in addressing OOD tasks.

    中文

    本文探讨上下文学习（ICL）在训练期间未遇到的分布外（OOD）任务上的机制。为此，我们使用 GPT-2 模型开展合成实验，目标是通过 ICL 学习 OOD 数学函数。我们发现，Transformer 可能难以通过 ICL 学习 OOD 任务函数。具体而言，ICL 的表现类似于在预训练假设空间中实现一个函数，并根据上下文示例通过梯度下降对其进行优化。此外，我们研究了 ICL 众所周知的在上下文中学习未见过的抽象标签的能力。我们证明，这种能力只会出现在不存在分布偏移的情形中，因此可能不能作为具备新任务学习能力的证据。此外，我们还评估了模型在经过多任务预训练后于 OOD 任务上的 ICL 表现。实证和理论分析均表明，ICL 存在**低测试误差偏好**：它倾向于实现一个能在测试上下文中产生较低测试误差的预训练函数。我们通过数值实验验证了这一点。这一新的理论结果结合我们的实证发现，阐明了 ICL 处理 OOD 任务的机制。

    Memory Mosaics

    记忆拼图

    Jianyu Zhang, Niklas Nolte, Ranajoy Sadhukhan, Beidi Chen, Leon Bottou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents associative-memory networks with compositional and in-context learning capabilities, emphasizing transparent predictive disentanglement. This offers substantial insight into representation and composition; the prediction-task setting alone provides little evidence about reasoning mechanisms or broader system design.

    本文提出了具备组合能力和上下文学习能力的联想记忆网络，并强调其预测性解耦具有透明性。这为表征和组合提供了重要见解；单凭预测任务的设置，对推理机制或更广泛的系统设计只能提供有限证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory Mosaics are networks of associative memories working in concert to achieve a prediction task of interest. Like transformers, memory mosaics possess compositional capabilities and in-context learning capabilities. Unlike transformers, memory mosaics achieve these capabilities in comparatively transparent way (“predictive disentanglement”). We illustrate these capabilities on a toy example and also show that memory mosaics perform as well or better than transformers on medium-scale language modeling tasks.

    中文

    记忆拼图是由多个联想记忆协同工作的网络，用于完成所关注的预测任务。与 Transformer 一样，记忆拼图具备组合能力和上下文学习能力。与 Transformer 不同的是，记忆拼图以一种相对透明的方式（“预测性解耦”）实现这些能力。我们通过一个玩具示例展示了这些能力，并且还表明，在中等规模的语言建模任务上，记忆拼图的表现与 Transformer 相当或更好。

    Tell me about yourself: LLMs are aware of their learned behaviors

    告诉我关于你自己的事：LLM 知晓自己习得的行为

    Jan Betley, Xuchan Bao, Martín Soto, Anna Sztyber-Betley, James Chua, Owain Evans

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that fine-tuned LLMs can describe acquired behavioral policies and distinguish which persona holds them, including backdoor-like behaviors, offering evidence about learned-behavior knowledge and its articulation. This is relevant to how models represent and report learned behavior, but the abstract does not establish internal mechanisms or compositional generalization, and the reasoning is an evaluation method rather than the central contribution.

    本文表明，经过微调的 LLM 能够描述习得的行为策略，并区分各策略分别属于哪个人设，其中也包括类似后门的行为；这为模型对习得行为的认知及其表达提供了证据。这与模型如何表征和报告习得行为有关，但摘要没有确立其内部机制或组合泛化能力，而且推理在此是评估方法，而非核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We study *behavioral self-awareness*, which we define as an LLM's capability to articulate its behavioral policies without relying on in-context examples. We finetune LLMs on examples that exhibit particular behaviors, including (a) making risk-seeking / risk-averse economic decisions, and (b) making the user say a certain word. Although these examples never contain explicit descriptions of the policy (e.g. "I will now take the risk-seeking option"), we find that the finetuned LLMs can explicitly describe their policies through out-of-context reasoning. We demonstrate LLMs' behavioral self-awareness across various evaluation tasks, both for multiple-choice and free-form questions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that models can correctly attribute different learned policies to distinct personas. Finally, we explore the connection between behavioral self-awareness and the concept of backdoors in AI safety, where certain behaviors are implanted in a model, often through data poisoning, and can be triggered under certain conditions. We find evidence that LLMs can recognize the existence of the backdoor-like behavior that they have acquired through fine-tuning.

    中文

    我们研究“行为自我觉察”，并将其定义为 LLM 无需依赖上下文示例就能阐述自身行为策略的能力。我们用展示特定行为的示例对 LLM 进行微调，包括 (a) 做出风险偏好型／风险规避型的经济决策，以及 (b) 促使用户说出某个特定词语。尽管这些示例从未明确描述策略（例如“我现在将选择风险偏好的选项”），我们发现，微调后的 LLM 能够通过脱离上下文的推理明确描述自己的策略。我们通过多种评估任务展示了 LLM 的行为自我觉察，评估题型包括选择题和开放式问题。 此外，我们表明，模型能够将不同的习得策略正确归属于不同的人设。 最后，我们探讨了行为自我觉察与 AI 安全中的后门概念之间的联系：某些行为会被植入模型（通常通过数据投毒），并可能在特定条件下被触发。我们发现，有证据表明，LLM 能够识别自己通过微调习得的、类似后门的行为。

    From Attention to Activation: Unraveling the Enigmas of Large Language Models

    从注意力到激活：揭开大型语言模型的谜团

    Prannay Kaul, Chengcheng Ma, Ismail Elezi, Jiankang Deng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper investigates attention dominance and hidden-state outlier activations, attributing them to softmax and adaptive optimizers, and proposes changes that reduce these effects while preserving quantized performance. This provides substantial insight into internal model behavior, but the abstract does not address composition, reasoning, or system organization beyond incidental optimization and quantization.

    本文研究注意力偏向第一个 token 和隐状态离群激活这两种现象，将其分别归因于 softmax 和自适应优化器，并提出了能减轻这些现象、同时保持量化后性能的方法。这为理解模型内部行为提供了重要见解，但摘要没有涉及组合、推理或系统组织，优化和量化只是附带内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We study two strange phenomena in auto-regressive Transformers: (1) the dominance of the ﬁrst token in attention heads; (2) the occurrence of large outlier activations in the hidden states. We ﬁnd that popular large language models, such as Llama attend maximally to the first token in 98% of attention heads, a behaviour we attribute to the softmax function. To mitigate this issue, we propose a reformulation of softmax to softmax-1. Furthermore, we identify adaptive optimisers, e.g. Adam, as the primary contributor to the large outlier activations and introduce OrthoAdam, a novel optimiser that utilises orthogonal matrices to transform gradients, to address this issue. Finally, not only do our methods prevent these phenomena from occurring, but additionally, they enable Transformers to sustain their performance when quantised using basic algorithms, something that standard methods are unable to do. In summary, our methods reduce the attention proportion on the first token from 65% to 3.3%, the activation kurtosis in the hidden states from 1657 to 3.1, and perplexity penalty under 4-bit weight quantisation from 3565 to 0.3. Code is available at https://github.com/prannaykaul/OrthoAdam

    中文

    我们研究自回归 Transformer 中的两种反常现象：(1) 注意力头对第一个 token 的偏重；(2) 隐状态中出现较大的离群激活。我们发现，Llama 等广受欢迎的大型语言模型在 98% 的注意力头中会对第一个 token 分配最大注意力，我们将这一行为归因于 softmax 函数。为缓解这一问题，我们提出对 softmax 的重新表述，即 softmax-1。此外，我们将自适应优化器（如 Adam）确定为产生较大离群激活的主要因素，并提出一种新型优化器 OrthoAdam，它利用正交矩阵变换梯度来解决这一问题。最后，我们的方法不仅能防止这些现象出现，还能使 Transformer 在使用基础算法进行量化时保持性能，而标准方法无法做到这一点。总之，我们的方法将第一个 token 所占的注意力比例从 65% 降至 3.3%，将隐状态中的激活峰度从 1657 降至 3.1，并将 4 位权重量化下的困惑度惩罚从 3565 降至 0.3。代码见 https://github.com/prannaykaul/OrthoAdam

    Sparse components distinguish visual pathways & their alignment to neural networks

    稀疏成分区分视觉通路及其与神经网络的对齐关系

    Ammar I Marvi, Nancy Kanwisher, Meenakshi Khosla

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Sparse decomposition identifies interpretable components in human visual pathways, and Sparse Component Alignment measures brain–network alignment along latent tuning axes. This substantially advances representation analysis, though the focus is comparative neuroscience rather than mechanisms inside AI models.

    稀疏分解找出了人类视觉通路中可解释的成分，稀疏成分对齐则沿潜在调谐轴衡量大脑与网络的对齐程度。这显著推进了表征分析，但研究重点是比较神经科学，而非 AI 模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The ventral, dorsal, and lateral streams in high-level human visual cortex are implicated in distinct functional processes. Yet, deep neural networks (DNNs) trained on a single task model the entire visual system surprisingly well, hinting at common computational principles across these pathways. To explore this inconsistency, we applied a novel sparse decomposition approach to identify the dominant components of visual representations within each stream. Consistent with traditional neuroscience research, we find a clear difference in component response profiles across the three visual streams—identifying components selective for faces, places, bodies, text, and food in the ventral stream; social interactions, implied motion, and hand actions in the lateral stream; and some less interpretable components in the dorsal stream. Building on this, we introduce Sparse Component Alignment (SCA), a new method for measuring representational alignment between brains and machines that better captures the latent neural tuning of these two visual systems. We find that standard visual DNNs are more aligned with ventral than either dorsal or lateral representations. SCA reveals these distinctions with greater resolution than conventional population-level geometry, offering a measure of representational alignment that is sensitive to a system’s underlying axes of neural tuning.

    中文

    人类高级视觉皮层中的腹侧、背侧和外侧通路分别与不同的功能过程有关。然而，在单一任务上训练的深度神经网络（DNN）竟能很好地模拟整个视觉系统，这暗示这些通路之间存在共同的计算原理。为探究这一不一致之处，我们采用一种新颖的稀疏分解方法，找出每条通路中视觉表征的主要成分。与传统神经科学研究的发现一致，我们发现三条视觉通路中的成分响应特征有明显差异：腹侧通路中有选择性响应面孔、地点、身体、文本和食物的成分；外侧通路中有响应社交互动、暗示运动和手部动作的成分；而背侧通路中则有一些较难解释的成分。在此基础上，我们提出稀疏成分对齐（SCA），这是一种衡量大脑与机器之间表征对齐程度的新方法，能更好地捕捉这两种视觉系统潜在的神经调谐特征。我们发现，标准视觉 DNN 与腹侧表征的对齐程度高于与背侧或外侧表征的对齐程度。与传统的总体水平几何分析相比，SCA 能以更高的分辨率揭示这些差异，为衡量表征对齐提供了一种对系统底层神经调谐轴敏感的方法。

    Improving Reasoning Performance in Large Language Models via Representation Engineering

    通过表征工程提升大型语言模型的推理表现

    Bertram Højer, Oliver Simon Jarvis, Stefan Heinrich

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper intervenes on LLM residual-stream activations with control vectors, analyzes their effects on representations and outputs, and reports improved reasoning benchmark performance. This gives substantive evidence about representation modulation and reasoning, while inference-time activation control alone offers only an incidental connection to broader systems design.

    本文通过控制向量干预 LLM 的残差流激活值，分析这些干预对表征和输出的影响，并报告了推理基准表现的提升。这为表征调节和推理提供了实质性证据，而推理时激活控制与更广泛系统设计的联系仅属附带。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have resulted in increasingly anthropomorphic language concerning the ability of LLMs to reason. Whether \textit{reasoning} in LLMs should be understood to be inherently different is, however, widely debated. We propose utilizing a representation engineering approach wherein model activations are read from the residual stream of an LLM when processing a reasoning task. The activations are used to derive a control vector that is applied to the model as an inference-time intervention, modulating the representational space of the model, to improve performance on the specified task. We publish the code for deriving control vectors and analyzing model representations. The method allows us to improve performance on reasoning benchmarks and assess how control vectors influence the final logit distribution of a model via metrics such as KL divergence and entropy. We apply control vectors to Mistral-7B-Instruct and a range of Pythia models on an inductive, a deductive and mathematical reasoning task. We show that an LLM can, to a certain degree, be controlled to improve its perceived reasoning ability by modulating activations. The intervention is dependent upon the ability to reliably extract the model's typical state when correctly solving a task. Our results suggest that reasoning performance can be modulated in the same manner as other information-processing tasks performed by LLMs and demonstrate that we are capable of improving performance on specific tasks via a simple intervention on the residual stream with no additional training.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）的近期进展，使得人们越来越多地使用拟人化语言来描述 LLM 的推理能力。然而，LLM 中的“推理”是否应被视为本质上不同的能力，仍广受争议。我们提出采用表征工程方法：在 LLM 处理推理任务时，从其残差流中读取模型激活值。利用这些激活值导出一个控制向量，并在推理时将其作为干预施加于模型，调节模型的表征空间，从而提升其在指定任务上的表现。我们公开了用于导出控制向量和分析模型表征的代码。该方法能够提升模型在推理基准上的表现，并可通过 KL 散度和熵等指标评估控制向量对模型最终 logit 分布的影响。我们在 Mistral-7B-Instruct 和一系列 Pythia 模型上，将控制向量应用于归纳推理、演绎推理和数学推理任务。我们表明，通过调节激活值，可以在一定程度上控制 LLM，提升其表面上的推理能力。该干预取决于能否可靠地提取模型正确完成任务时的典型状态。我们的结果表明，推理表现可以像 LLM 执行的其他信息处理任务一样进行调节，并证明无需额外训练，仅通过对残差流进行简单干预，就能提升模型在特定任务上的表现。

    What Makes a Maze Look Like a Maze?

    迷宫看起来像迷宫的原因是什么？

    Joy Hsu, Jiayuan Mao, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Noah Goodman, Jiajun Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Deep Schema Grounding decomposes visual abstractions into reusable symbols and dependency structures, then grounds them hierarchically to support transfer across images. This substantially advances compositional representation and visual reasoning, though the abstract does not study models’ internal representations.

    深度图式落地将视觉抽象概念分解为可复用的符号和依赖结构，再通过分层方式将其落到图像上，以支持跨图像迁移。这显著推进了组合表征和视觉推理方面的研究，但摘要没有研究模型的内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A unique aspect of human visual understanding is the ability to flexibly interpret abstract concepts: acquiring lifted rules explaining what they symbolize, grounding them across familiar and unfamiliar contexts, and making predictions or reasoning about them. While off-the-shelf vision-language models excel at making literal interpretations of images (e.g., recognizing object categories such as tree branches), they still struggle to make sense of such visual abstractions (e.g., how an arrangement of tree branches may form the walls of a maze). To address this challenge, we introduce Deep Schema Grounding (DSG), a framework that leverages explicit structured representations of visual abstractions for grounding and reasoning. At the core of DSG are schemas—dependency graph descriptions of abstract concepts that decompose them into more primitive-level symbols. DSG uses large language models to extract schemas, then hierarchically grounds concrete to abstract components of the schema onto images with vision-language models. The grounded schema is used to augment visual abstraction understanding. We systematically evaluate DSG and different methods in reasoning on our new Visual Abstractions Benchmark, which consists of diverse, real-world images of abstract concepts and corresponding question-answer pairs labeled by humans. We show that DSG significantly improves the abstract visual reasoning performance of vision-language models, and is a step toward human-aligned understanding of visual abstractions.

    中文

    人类视觉理解的一个独特方面，是能够灵活地理解抽象概念：获得解释这些概念象征什么的抽象规则，将其落到熟悉和陌生的情境中，并据此进行预测或推理。现成的视觉语言模型擅长对图像作字面解释（例如识别树枝等物体类别），但仍难以理解这类视觉抽象概念（例如树枝的排列如何构成迷宫的墙壁）。为应对这一挑战，我们提出深度图式落地（DSG）框架，利用视觉抽象概念的显式结构化表征来支持落地和推理。DSG 的核心是图式，即以依赖图描述抽象概念，并将其分解为更基本层次的符号。DSG 使用大型语言模型提取图式，然后用视觉语言模型将图式中从具体到抽象的组成部分分层落到图像上。落地后的图式用于增强对视觉抽象概念的理解。我们在新建的视觉抽象基准上，对 DSG 和不同推理方法进行了系统评估。该基准由多样的真实世界抽象概念图像，以及由人工标注的对应问答对组成。我们表明，DSG 显著提升了视觉语言模型的抽象视觉推理表现，是迈向符合人类认知的视觉抽象理解的一步。

    Learning Dynamics of Deep Matrix Factorization Beyond the Edge of Stability

    超越稳定性边缘的深度矩阵分解学习动态

    Avrajit Ghosh, Soo Min Kwon, Rongrong Wang, Saiprasad Ravishankar, Qing Qu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper theoretically characterizes deep linear network training beyond the edge of stability, including loss oscillations in a learning-rate-dependent subspace and the breakdown of a symmetry-induced conservation law. This gives substantial insight into training dynamics and feature structure, while any connection to reasoning or compositionality is not supported by the abstract.

    本文从理论上刻画了深度线性网络在稳定性边缘之外的训练动态，包括学习率决定的子空间中的损失振荡，以及对称性诱导守恒定律的失效。这为理解训练动态和特征结构提供了重要见解；摘要没有支持其与推理或组合性的联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep neural networks trained using gradient descent with a fixed learning rate $\eta$ often operate in the regime of ``edge of stability'' (EOS), where the largest eigenvalue of the Hessian equilibrates about the stability threshold $2/\eta$. In this work, we present a fine-grained analysis of the learning dynamics of (deep) linear networks (DLNs) within the deep matrix factorization loss beyond EOS. For DLNs, loss oscillations beyond EOS follow a period-doubling route to chaos. We theoretically analyze the regime of the 2-period orbit and show that the loss oscillations occur within a small subspace, with the dimension of the subspace precisely characterized by the learning rate. The crux of our analysis lies in showing that the symmetry-induced conservation law for gradient flow, defined as the balancing gap among the singular values across layers, breaks at EOS and decays monotonically to zero. Overall, our results contribute to explaining two key phenomena in deep networks: (i) shallow models and simple tasks do not always exhibit EOS; and (ii) oscillations occur within top features}. We present experiments to support our theory, along with examples demonstrating how these phenomena occur in nonlinear networks and how they differ from those which have benign landscape such as in DLNs.

    中文

    使用固定学习率的梯度下降训练的深度神经网络 $\eta$通常处于“稳定性边缘”（EOS）区域，在该区域中，Hessian 的最大特征值会在稳定性阈值 $2/\eta$附近达到平衡。在这项工作中，我们对 EOS 之外深度矩阵分解损失下（深度）线性网络（DLN）的学习动态进行了细致分析。对于 DLN，EOS 之外的损失振荡沿着周期倍增路径走向混沌。我们从理论上分析了 2 周期轨道区域，并表明损失振荡发生在一个小子空间内，该子空间的维数可由学习率精确确定。我们分析的关键在于证明：梯度流中由对称性诱导的守恒定律（定义为各层奇异值之间的平衡差）会在 EOS 处失效，并单调衰减至零。总体而言，我们的结果有助于解释深度网络中的两个关键现象：(i) 浅层模型和简单任务并不总是表现出 EOS；(ii) 振荡发生在顶层特征中。我们通过实验支持理论，并举例说明这些现象如何出现在非线性网络中，以及它们与具有良性景观的情形（如 DLN）有何不同。

    Efficiently Democratizing Medical LLMs for 50 Languages via a Mixture of Language Family Experts

    通过语言家族专家混合，高效普及面向 50 种语言的医疗 LLM

    Guorui Zheng, Xidong Wang, Juhao Liang, Nuo Chen, Yuping Zheng, Benyou Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes multilingual information flow across model layers and uses that finding to design sparse, language-specific expert routing, a substantial contribution to internal mechanisms and conditional computation. Language-family experts support cross-language transfer, but the abstract does not directly study compositional generalization.

    本文分析了模型层间的多语言信息流，并据此设计了稀疏的特定语言专家路由，对内部机制和条件计算作出了重要贡献。语言家族专家有助于跨语言迁移，但摘要没有直接研究组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adapting medical Large Language Models to local languages can reduce barriers to accessing healthcare services, but data scarcity remains a significant challenge, particularly for low-resource languages. To address this, we first construct a high-quality medical dataset and conduct analysis to ensure its quality. In order to leverage the generalization capability of multilingual LLMs to efficiently scale to more resource-constrained languages, we explore the internal information flow of LLMs from a multilingual perspective using Mixture of Experts (MoE) modularity. Technically, we propose a novel MoE routing method that employs language-specific experts and cross-lingual routing. Inspired by circuit theory, our routing analysis revealed a \textit{``Spread Out in the End``} information flow mechanism: while earlier layers concentrate cross-lingual information flow, the later layers exhibit language-specific divergence. This insight directly led to the development of the Post-MoE architecture, which applies sparse routing only in the later layers while maintaining dense others. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach enhances the generalization of multilingual models to other languages while preserving interpretability. Finally, to efficiently scale the model to 50 languages, we introduce the concept of \textit{language family} experts, drawing on linguistic priors, which enables scaling the number of languages without adding additional parameters.

    中文

    将医疗领域的大型语言模型适配到本地语言，有助于降低医疗服务的获取门槛，但数据稀缺仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在资源匮乏的语言中。为解决这一问题，我们首先构建了一个高质量医疗数据集，并通过分析确保其质量。为了利用多语言 LLM 的泛化能力，高效扩展至资源更受限的语言，我们从多语言视角出发，借助混合专家（MoE）模块化机制，探索 LLM 内部的信息流。具体而言，我们提出了一种新颖的 MoE 路由方法，采用特定语言的专家和跨语言路由。受电路理论启发，我们的路由分析揭示了一种“末端扩散”（``Spread Out in the End``）信息流机制：较早的层会集中跨语言信息流，而较后的层则呈现语言特定的分化。这一发现直接促成了 Post-MoE 架构的开发，该架构仅在较后的层应用稀疏路由，其余层则保持稠密。实验结果表明，这种方法在保持可解释性的同时，增强了多语言模型向其他语言的泛化能力。最后，为了将模型高效扩展到 50 种语言，我们借鉴语言学先验，提出“语言家族”专家这一概念，使模型能够在不增加额外参数的情况下扩展所支持的语言数量。

    From Models to Microtheories: Distilling a Model's Topical Knowledge for Grounded Question-Answering

    从模型到微理论：提炼模型的主题知识以实现有据可依的问答

    Nathaniel Weir, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Orion Weller, Oyvind Tafjord, Sam Hornstein, Alexander Sabol, Peter Jansen, Benjamin Van Durme, Peter Clark

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper distills topic-specific knowledge into concise microtheories that support answer grounding and provides a measure of topic coverage, offering a transferable method for exposing and using a model’s knowledge. The sentences systematically entail answers, but the abstract does not center on compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文将主题知识提炼为简洁的微理论，用于支持答案溯源，并提出主题覆盖度的度量方法，为揭示和利用模型知识提供了一种可迁移的方法。这些句子能够系统地蕴含答案，但摘要的重点并非组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent reasoning methods (e.g., chain-of-thought) help users understand how language models (LMs) answer a single question, but they do little to reveal the LM’s overall understanding, or “theory,” about the question’s topic, making it still hard to trust the model. Our goal is to materialize such theories - here called microtheories (a linguistic analog of logical microtheories) - as a set of sentences encapsulating an LM’s core knowledge about a topic. These statements systematically work together to entail answers to a set of questions to both engender trust and improve performance. Our approach is to first populate a knowledge store with (model-generated) sentences that entail answers to training questions, and then distill those down to a core microtheory which is concise, general, and non-redundant. We show that, when added to a general corpus (e.g., Wikipedia), microtheories can supply critical information not necessarily present in the corpus, improving both a model’s ability to ground its answers to verifiable knowledge (i.e., show how answers are systematically entailed by documents in the corpus, grounding up to +8% more answers), and the accuracy of those grounded answers (up to +8% absolute). We also show that, in a human evaluation in the medical domain, our distilled microtheories contain a significantly higher concentration of topically critical facts than the non-distilled knowledge store. Finally, we show we can quantify the coverage of a microtheory for a topic (characterized by a dataset) using a notion of p-relevance. Together, these suggest that microtheories are an efficient distillation of an LM’s topic-relevant knowledge, that they can usefully augment existing corpora, and can provide both performance gains and an interpretable, verifiable window into the model’s knowledge of a topic.

    中文

    近期的推理方法（例如思维链）有助于用户理解语言模型（LM）如何回答单个问题，但对揭示 LM 对问题主题的整体理解或“理论”帮助有限，因此仍难以信任模型。我们的目标是将这类理论具体化——在此称为微理论（语言学意义上的逻辑微理论的类比）——即一组概括 LM 对某个主题核心知识的句子。这些陈述能够系统地协同工作，蕴含一组问题的答案，从而建立信任并提升性能。我们的方法首先用（模型生成的）句子填充知识库，这些句子蕴含训练问题的答案；然后将其提炼为精炼、通用且不冗余的核心微理论。我们表明，将微理论加入通用语料库（例如 Wikipedia）后，可以提供语料库中未必包含的关键信息，既提升模型以可验证知识为依据作答的能力（即展示答案如何由语料库中的文档系统地蕴含出来，使有依据的答案最多增加 +8%），也提升这些有据可依答案的准确性（绝对提升最多 +8%）。我们还通过医疗领域的人工评估表明，与未提炼的知识库相比，提炼后的微理论包含的主题关键事实占比显著更高。最后，我们展示了可以使用 p-relevance 概念，量化某个主题（由数据集刻画）的微理论覆盖度。总而言之，这些结果表明，微理论能够高效提炼 LM 的主题相关知识，可用于补充现有语料库，并在带来性能提升的同时，为模型掌握的主题知识提供可解释、可验证的窗口。

In this work, we propose a feature learning framework aimed at analyzing and comparing the training dynamics of diffusion models with those of traditional classification models. In contrast, neural networks with a similar architecture trained for classification tend to prioritize learning specific patterns in the data, often focusing on easy-to-learn components.     Diffusion models break down the challenging task of generating data from high-dimensional distributions into a series of easier denoising steps. Inspired by this paradigm, we propose a novel approach that extends the diffusion framework into modality space, decomposing the complex task of RGB image generation into simpler, interpretable stages. Our method, termed {\papernameAbbrev}, cascades modality-specific models, each responsible for generating an intermediate representation, such as contours, palettes, and detailed textures, ultimately culminating in a high-quality RGB image. Instead of relying on the naive LDM concatenation conditioning mechanism to connect the different stages together, we employ Schr\"odinger Bridge to determine the optimal transport between different modalities. Although employing a cascaded pipeline introduces more stages, which could lead to a more complex architecture, each stage is meticulously formulated for efficiency and accuracy, surpassing Stable-Diffusion (LDM) performance. Modality composition not only enhances overall performance but enables emerging proprieties such as consistent editing, interaction capabilities, high-level interpretability, and faster convergence and sampling rate. Extensive experiments on diverse datasets, including LSUN-Churches, ImageNet, CelebHQ, and LAION-Art, demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. For instance, {\papernameAbbrev} achieves notable efficiency, matching LDM performance on LSUN-Churches while operating 2$\times$ faster with a 3$\times$ smaller architecture. The project website is available at: \href{https://toddlerdiffusion.github.io/website/}{$https://toddlerdiffusion.github.io/website/$}

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TIF builds hierarchical graph coarsenings and routes through them to provide multi-granular explanations of GNN predictions, substantially advancing model interpretability.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Interpretable Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) aim to reveal the underlying reasoning behind model predictions, attributing their decisions to specific subgraphs that are informative. However, existing subgraph-based interpretable methods suffer from an overemphasis on local structure, potentially overlooking long-range dependencies within the entire graphs. Although recent efforts that rely on graph coarsening have proven beneficial for global interpretability, they inevitably reduce the graphs to a fixed granularity. Such an inflexible way can only capture graph connectivity at a specific level, whereas real-world graph tasks often exhibit relationships at varying granularities (e.g., relevant interactions in proteins span from functional groups, to amino acids, and up to protein domains). In this paper, we introduce a novel Tree-like Interpretable Framework (TIF) for graph classification, where plain GNNs are transformed into hierarchical trees, with each level featuring coarsened graphs of different granularity as tree nodes. Specifically, TIF iteratively adopts a graph coarsening module to compress original graphs (i.e., root nodes of trees) into increasingly coarser ones (i.e., child nodes of trees), while preserving diversity among tree nodes within different branches through a dedicated graph perturbation module. Finally, we propose an adaptive routing module to identify the most informative root-to-leaf paths, providing not only the final prediction but also the multi-granular interpretability for the decision-making process. Extensive experiments on the graph classification benchmarks with both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of TIF in interpretability, while also delivering a competitive prediction performance akin to the state-of-the-art counterparts.

    中文

    可解释图神经网络（GNN）旨在揭示模型预测背后的推理过程，将其决策归因于具有信息量的特定子图。然而，现有基于子图的可解释方法过度强调局部结构，可能会忽略整个图中的长程依赖关系。尽管近期依赖图粗化的方法已被证明有益于全局可解释性，但它们不可避免地会将图压缩到固定粒度。这种不灵活的方式只能捕捉特定层级的图连通性，而现实世界的图任务往往呈现不同粒度的关系（例如，蛋白质中的相关相互作用范围从功能基团、氨基酸到蛋白质结构域）。本文提出一种用于图分类的新型类树可解释框架（TIF），将普通 GNN 转化为层次树，其中每一层都以不同粒度的粗化图作为树节点。具体来说，TIF 迭代采用图粗化模块，将原始图（即树的根节点）压缩为越来越粗化的图（即树的子节点），同时通过专门的图扰动模块，保留不同分支上树节点之间的多样性。最后，我们提出自适应路由模块来识别信息量最大的根到叶路径，从而不仅给出最终预测，还能对决策过程提供多粒度解释。在包含合成数据集和真实世界数据集的图分类基准上进行的大量实验表明，TIF 在可解释性方面表现优越，同时预测性能也与最先进方法相当。

    Sunny Duan, Mikail Khona, Abhiram Iyer, Rylan Schaeffer, Ila R Fiete

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper investigates how single-exposure sequences become latent, recoverable memories during training and proposes ways to reveal and diagnose them, providing substantial insight into model memory and stored information.     本文研究了单次出现的序列如何在训练过程中成为潜在且可恢复的记忆，并提出了揭示和诊断它们的方法，从而深入揭示了模型记忆及其存储信息。这与系统领域有较强但非核心的关联；本文关注的并非记忆使用架构或持久化智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Frontier AI systems are making transformative impacts across society, but such benefits are not without costs: models trained on web-scale datasets containing personal and private data raise profound concerns about data privacy and security. Language models are trained on extensive corpora including potentially sensitive or proprietary information, and the risk of data leakage, where the model response reveals pieces of such information, remains inadequately understood. Prior work has investigated that sequence complexity and the number of repetitions are the primary drivers of memorization. In this work, we examine the most vulnerable class of data: highly complex sequences that are presented only once during training. These sequences often contain the most sensitive information and pose considerable risk if memorized. By analyzing the progression of memorization for these sequences throughout training, we uncover a striking observation: many memorized sequences persist in the model's memory, exhibiting resistance to catastrophic forgetting even after just one encounter. Surprisingly, these sequences may not appear memorized immediately after their first exposure but can later be “uncovered” during training, even in the absence of subsequent exposures - a phenomenon we call "latent memorization." Latent memorization presents a serious challenge for data privacy, as sequences that seem hidden at the final checkpoint of a model may still be easily recoverable. We demonstrate how these hidden sequences can be revealed through random weight perturbations, and we introduce a diagnostic test based on cross-entropy loss to accurately identify latent memorized sequences.

    中文

    前沿 AI 系统正在对社会产生变革性影响，但这些益处也伴随着代价：在包含个人和隐私数据的网络规模数据集上训练的模型，引发了对数据隐私与安全的深刻担忧。语言模型在包括潜在敏感或专有信息在内的大型语料库上训练，而数据泄露风险——即模型回复泄露这类信息的片段——仍未得到充分理解。先前研究探讨了序列复杂度和重复次数是记忆的主要驱动因素。在这项工作中，我们考察最脆弱的数据类别：训练期间只出现一次的高度复杂序列。这些序列往往包含最敏感的信息，一旦被记住便会带来相当大的风险。通过分析这些序列在整个训练过程中的记忆变化，我们发现了一个显著现象：许多被记住的序列会持续留在模型记忆中，即使只经历一次也能抵抗灾难性遗忘。令人惊讶的是，这些序列在首次接触后可能看起来并未被记住，但之后即使没有再次出现，也可能在训练过程中被“揭示”出来——我们将这一现象称为“潜在记忆”。潜在记忆对数据隐私构成严重挑战，因为在模型最终检查点看似隐藏的序列仍可能轻易被恢复。我们展示了如何通过随机权重扰动揭示这些隐藏序列，并提出一种基于交叉熵损失的诊断测试，以准确识别潜在记忆序列。

    Zhihai Wang, Jie Wang, Xilin Xia, Dongsheng Zuo, Lei Chen, Yuzhe Ma, Jianye HAO, Mingxuan Yuan, Feng Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MUTE searches circuit designs with a genetic representation and multi-granularity crossover that recombines substructures, with reported transfer to larger circuits. This is a substantial contribution in structured composition and recombination, while its RL comparison concerns the optimization formulation rather than advancing general reasoning; circuit design is not model or agent systems work.

    MUTE 使用遗传表示和多粒度交叉搜索电路设计，通过重组子结构，并报告了向更大规模电路的迁移效果。这是对结构化组合与重组的实质性贡献；其与 RL 的比较涉及优化问题的形式化方式，而非推进一般推理；电路设计也不属于模型或智能体系统研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Optimizing computing circuits such as multipliers and adders is a fundamental challenge in modern integrated circuit design. Recent efforts propose formulating this optimization problem as a reinforcement learning (RL) proxy task, offering a promising approach to search high-speed and area-efficient circuit design solutions. However, we show that the RL-based formulation (proxy task) converges to a local optimal design solution (original task) due to the deceptive reward signals and incrementally localized actions in the RL-based formulation. To address this challenge, we propose a novel model-based circuit genetic evolution (MUTE) framework, which reformulates the problem as a genetic evolution process by proposing a grid-based genetic representation of design solutions. This novel formulation avoids misleading rewards by evaluating and improving generated solutions using the true objective value rather than proxy rewards. To promote globally diverse exploration, MUTE proposes a multi-granularity genetic crossover operator that recombines design substructures at varying column ranges between two grid-based genetic solutions. To the best of our knowledge, MUTE is the first to reformulate the problem as a circuit genetic evolution process, which enables effectively searching for global optimal design solutions. We evaluate MUTE on several fundamental computing circuits, including multipliers, adders, and multiply-accumulate circuits. Experiments on these circuits demonstrate that MUTE significantly Pareto-dominates state-of-the-art approaches in terms of both area and delay. Moreover, experiments demonstrate that circuits designed by MUTE well generalize to large-scale computation-intensive circuits as well.

    中文

    优化乘法器和加法器等计算电路，是现代集成电路设计中的一项基础挑战。近期研究提出将这一优化问题构造成强化学习（RL）代理任务，为搜索高速且面积高效的电路设计方案提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，我们表明，由于 RL 形式化方案中的奖励信号具有欺骗性，且动作是逐步进行的局部操作，基于 RL 的形式化方案（代理任务）会收敛到局部最优的设计方案（原始任务）。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种新颖的基于模型的电路遗传进化（MUTE）框架，通过提出基于网格的设计方案遗传表示，将该问题重新表述为遗传进化过程。这种新形式化方案通过使用真实目标值而非代理奖励来评估和改进生成的方案，从而避免误导性奖励。为促进全局多样化探索，MUTE 提出了一种多粒度遗传交叉算子，可在两个基于网格的遗传方案之间，以不同的列范围重组设计子结构。据我们所知，MUTE 是首个将该问题重新表述为电路遗传进化过程的方法，从而能够有效搜索全局最优设计方案。我们在若干基础计算电路上评估了 MUTE，包括乘法器、加法器和乘累加电路。在这些电路上的实验表明，就面积和延迟而言，MUTE 显著地帕累托支配了当前最先进的方法。此外，实验还表明，MUTE 设计的电路能够很好地泛化到大规模计算密集型电路。

Among various special designs, adding a projection head on top of the encoder during training and removing it for downstream tasks has proven to significantly enhance the performance of contrastive learning. However, despite its empirical success, the underlying mechanism of the projection head remains under-explored. In this paper, we develop an in-depth theoretical understanding of the projection head from the information-theoretic perspective. By establishing the theoretical guarantees on the downstream performance of the features before the projector, we reveal that an effective projector should act as an information bottleneck, filtering out the information irrelevant to the contrastive objective. Based on theoretical insights, we introduce modifications to projectors with training and structural regularizations. Empirically, our methods exhibit consistent improvement in the downstream performance across various real-world datasets, including CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-100. We believe our theoretical understanding on the role of the projection head will inspire more principled and advanced designs in this field. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/PKU-ML/Projector_Theory}.

    Images generated by text-to-image (T2I) models often exhibit visual biases and stereotypes of concepts such as culture and profession. Existing quantitative measures of stereotypes are based on statistical parity that does not align with the sociological definition of stereotypes and, therefore, incorrectly categorizes biases as stereotypes. Instead of oversimplifying stereotypes as biases, we propose a quantitative measure of stereotypes that aligns with its sociological definition. We then propose OASIS to measure the stereotypes in a generated dataset and understand their origins within the T2I model. OASIS includes two scores to measure stereotypes from a generated image dataset: **(M1)** Stereotype Score to measure the distributional violation of stereotypical attributes, and **(M2)** WALS to measure spectral variance in the images along a stereotypical attribute. OASIS also includes two methods to understand the origins of stereotypes in T2I models: **(U1)** StOP to discover attributes that the T2I model internally associates with a given concept, and **(U2)** SPI to quantify the emergence of stereotypical attributes in the latent space of the T2I model during image generation. Despite the considerable progress in image fidelity, using OASIS, we conclude that newer T2I models such as FLUX.1 and SDv3 contain strong stereotypical predispositions about concepts and still generate images with widespread stereotypical attributes. Additionally, the quantity of stereotypes worsens for nationalities with lower Internet footprints.

    Hallucination poses a challenge to the deployment of large vision-language models (LVLMs) in applications. Unlike in large language models (LLMs), hallucination in LVLMs often arises from misalignments between visual inputs and textual outputs. This paper investigates the underlying mechanisms of hallucination, focusing on the unique structure of LVLMs that distinguishes them from LLMs. We identify that hallucinations often arise from the sensitivity of text decoders to vision inputs, a natural phenomenon when image encoders and text decoders are pre-trained separately. Inspired by this, we introduce Visual and Textual Intervention (VTI), a novel technique designed to reduce hallucinations by steering latent space representations during inference to enhance the stability of vision features. As a task-agnostic test-time intervention, VTI can be easily applied to any problem without additional training costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that it can effectively reduce hallucinations and outperform baseline methods across multiple metrics, highlighting the critical role of vision feature stability in LVLMs.

    What can we learn from comparing video models to human brains, arguably the most efficient and effective video processing systems in existence? Our work takes a step towards answering this question by performing the first large-scale benchmarking of deep video models on representational alignment to the human brain, using publicly available models and a recently released video brain imaging (fMRI) dataset. We disentangle four factors of variation in the models (temporal modeling, classification task, architecture, and training dataset) that affect alignment to the brain, which we measure by conducting Representational Similarity Analysis across multiple brain regions and model layers. We show that temporal modeling is key for alignment to brain regions involved in early visual processing, while a relevant classification task is key for alignment to higher-level regions. Moreover, we identify clear differences between the brain scoring patterns across layers of CNNs and Transformers, and reveal how training dataset biases transfer to alignment with functionally selective brain areas. Additionally, we uncover a negative correlation of computational complexity to brain alignment. Measuring a total of 99 neural networks and 10 human brains watching videos, we aim to forge a path that widens our understanding of temporal and semantic video representations in brains and machines, ideally leading towards more efficient video models and more mechanistic explanations of processing in the human brain.

    We contribute an unsupervised method that effectively learns disentangled content and style representations from sequences of observations. Unlike most disentanglement algorithms that rely on domain-specific labels or knowledge, our method is based on the insight of domain-general statistical differences between content and style --- content varies more among different fragments within a sample but maintains an invariant vocabulary across data samples, whereas style remains relatively invariant within a sample but exhibits more significant variation across different samples. We integrate such inductive bias into an encoder-decoder architecture and name our method after V3 (variance-versus-invariance). Experimental results show that V3 generalizes across multiple domains and modalities, successfully learning disentangled content and style representations, such as pitch and timbre from music audio, digit and color from images of hand-written digits, and action and character appearance from simple animations. V3 demonstrates strong disentanglement performance compared to existing unsupervised methods, along with superior out-of-distribution generalization and few-shot learning capabilities compared to supervised counterparts. Lastly, symbolic-level interpretability emerges in the learned content codebook, forging a near one-to-one alignment between machine representation and human knowledge.

In this work, we investigate methods to mitigate memorization: three regularizer-based, three fine-tuning-based, and eleven machine unlearning-based methods, with five of the latter being new methods that we introduce. We also introduce TinyMem, a suite of small, computationally-efficient LMs for the rapid development and evaluation of memorization-mitigation methods. We demonstrate that the mitigation methods that we develop using TinyMem can successfully be applied to production-grade LMs, and we determine via experiment that: regularizer-based mitigation methods are slow and ineffective at curbing memorization; fine-tuning-based methods are effective at curbing memorization, but overly expensive, especially for retaining higher accuracies; and unlearning-based methods are faster and more effective, allowing for the precise localization and removal of memorized information from LM weights prior to inference.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper empirically studies how learned facts prime unrelated LLM outputs, links the effect to pretraining token probabilities, and proposes update methods to reduce it.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models continually learn through the accumulation of gradient-based updates, but how individual pieces of new information affect existing knowledge, leading to both beneficial generalization and problematic hallucination, remains poorly understood. We demonstrate that when learning new information, LLMs exhibit a "priming" effect: learning a new fact can cause the model to inappropriately apply that knowledge in unrelated contexts. To systematically study this phenomenon, we introduce "Outlandish," a carefully curated dataset of 1320 diverse text samples designed to probe how new knowledge permeates through an LLM's existing knowledge base. Using this dataset, we show that the degree of priming after learning new information can be predicted by measuring the token probability of key words before training. This relationship holds robustly across different model architectures (PALM-2, Gemma, Llama), sizes, and training stages. Finally, we develop two novel techniques to modulate how new knowledge affects existing model behavior: (1) a ``stepping-stone'' text augmentation strategy and (2) an ``ignore-k'' update pruning method. These approaches reduce undesirable priming effects by 50-95% while preserving the model's ability to learn new information. Our findings provide both empirical insights into how LLMs learn and practical tools for improving the specificity of knowledge insertion in language models. Further materials: https://sunchipsster1.github.io/projects/outlandish/

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    An intriguing property of the Transformer is its ability to perform in-context learning (ICL), where the Transformer can solve different inference tasks without parameter updating based on the contextual information provided by the corresponding input-output demonstration pairs. It has been theoretically proved that ICL is enabled by the capability of Transformers to perform gradient-descent algorithms (Von Oswald et al., 2023a; Bai et al., 2024). This work takes a step further and shows that Transformers can perform learning-to-optimize (L2O) algorithms. Specifically, for the ICL sparse recovery (formulated as LASSO) tasks, we show that a K-layer Transformer can perform an L2O algorithm with a provable convergence rate linear in K. This provides a new perspective explaining the superior ICL capability of Transformers, even with only a few layers, which cannot be achieved by the standard gradient-descent algorithms. Moreover, unlike the conventional L2O algorithms that require the measurement matrix involved in training to match that in testing, the trained Transformer is able to solve sparse recovery problems generated with different measurement matrices. Besides, Transformers as an L2O algorithm can leverage structural information embedded in the training tasks to accelerate its convergence during ICL, and generalize across different lengths of demonstration pairs, where conventional L2O algorithms typically struggle or fail. Such theoretical findings are supported by our experimental results.
