    Towards Understanding the Universality of Transformers for Next-Token Prediction

    迈向理解 Transformer 在下一词元预测中的普适性

    Michael Eli Sander, Gabriel Peyré

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper theoretically constructs causal Transformers that learn context-dependent next-token mappings from observed sequences, with experiments supporting the analysis. This gives substantial insight into sequence-based learning and in-context computation, but the abstract does not investigate internal representations or model-system design.

    本文从理论上构造了能够根据观测序列学习依赖上下文的下一词元映射的因果 Transformer，并通过实验支持该分析。这为基于序列的学习和上下文内计算提供了深入见解，但摘要并未研究内部表征或模型系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Causal Transformers are trained to predict the next token for a given context. While it is widely accepted that self-attention is crucial for encoding the causal structure of sequences, the precise underlying mechanism behind this in-context autoregressive learning ability remains unclear. In this paper, we take a step towards understanding this phenomenon by studying the approximation ability of Transformers for next-token prediction. Specifically, we explore the capacity of causal Transformers to predict the next token $x_{t+1}$ given an autoregressive sequence $(x_1, \dots, x_t)$ as a prompt, where $ x_{t+1} = f(x_t) $, and $ f $ is a context-dependent function that varies with each sequence. On the theoretical side, we focus on specific instances, namely when $ f $ is linear or when $ (x_t)$ is periodic. We explicitly construct a Transformer (with linear, exponential, or softmax attention) that learns the mapping $f$ in-context through a causal kernel descent method. The causal kernel descent method we propose provably estimates $x_{t+1} $ based solely on past and current observations $ (x_1, \dots, x_t) $, with connections to the Kaczmarz algorithm in Hilbert spaces. We present experimental results that validate our theoretical findings and suggest their applicability to more general mappings $f$.

    中文

    因果 Transformer 经过训练，可根据给定上下文预测下一个词元。尽管人们普遍认为，自注意力对于编码序列的因果结构至关重要，但这种上下文内自回归学习能力背后的确切机制仍不清楚。本文通过研究 Transformer 在下一词元预测上的逼近能力，迈出理解这一现象的一步。具体而言，我们探讨因果 Transformer 预测下一个词元 $x_{t+1}$ 的能力，给定的自回归序列 $(x_1, \dots, x_t)$ 用作提示，且 $ x_{t+1} = f(x_t) $，而 $ f $ 是一个依赖于上下文、随每个序列而变化的函数。 在理论方面，我们聚焦于若干特定情形，即 $ f $ 为线性函数或 $ (x_t)$ 为周期函数的情形。我们明确构造了一个 Transformer（采用线性、指数或 softmax 注意力），它通过因果核下降方法在上下文中学习映射 $f$。我们证明，所提出的因果核下降方法可以估计 $x_{t+1} $，且仅依据过去与当前的观测 $ (x_1, \dots, x_t) $；该方法与希尔伯特空间中的 Kaczmarz 算法相关联。我们给出实验结果，以验证理论发现，并表明这些发现可能适用于更一般的映射 $f$。

    GOAL: A Generalist Combinatorial Optimization Agent Learner

    GOAL：通用组合优化智能体学习器

    Darko Drakulic, Sofia Michel, Jean-Marc Andreoli

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GOAL uses a shared backbone and adapters to transfer across combinatorial optimization problems, with architectural mechanisms for mixed features and heterogeneous types. Its reusable structure and transfer directly advance compositional generalization, while solving optimization problems gives a more limited connection to reasoning and agent systems.

    GOAL 使用共享主干网络和适配器，在组合优化问题之间迁移，并通过架构机制处理混合特征和异质类型。其可复用结构和迁移能力直接推动了组合泛化；而优化问题求解与推理及智能体系统的联系相对有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Machine Learning-based heuristics have recently shown impressive performance in solving a variety of hard combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). However they generally rely on a separate neural model, specialized and trained for each single problem. Any variation of a problem requires adjustment of its model and re-training from scratch. In this paper, we propose GOAL (for Generalist combinatorial Optimization Agent Learner), a generalist model capable of efficiently solving multiple COPs and which can be fine-tuned to solve new COPs. GOAL consists of a single backbone plus light-weight problem-specific adapters for input and output processing. The backbone is based on a new form of mixed-attention blocks which allows to handle problems defined on graphs with arbitrary combinations of node, edge and instance-level features. Additionally, problems which involve heterogeneous types of nodes or edges are handled through a novel multi-type transformer architecture, where the attention blocks are duplicated to attend the meaningful combinations of types while relying on the same shared parameters. We train GOAL on a set of routing, scheduling and classic graph problems and show that it is only slightly inferior to the specialized baselines while being the first multi-task model that solves a wide range of COPs. Finally we showcase the strong transfer learning capacity of GOAL by fine-tuning it on several new problems. Our code is available at https://github.com/naver/goal-co .

    中文

    近年来，基于机器学习的启发式方法在解决各种困难的组合优化问题（COP）方面表现出色。然而，这些方法通常针对每个问题分别依赖一个专门训练的神经模型。问题稍有变化，就需要调整模型并从头重新训练。本文提出 GOAL（Generalist combinatorial Optimization Agent Learner，通用组合优化智能体学习器），这是一个通用模型，能够高效解决多个 COP，并可通过微调来解决新的 COP。GOAL 由一个主干网络和轻量级的特定问题适配器组成，用于输入与输出处理。其主干网络基于一种新型混合注意力模块，可处理图上定义且包含节点、边和实例级特征任意组合的问题。此外，对于涉及异质节点类型或边类型的问题，GOAL 采用新颖的多类型 transformer 架构：复制注意力模块，使其关注有意义的类型组合，同时共享同一组参数。我们在一组路径规划、调度和经典图问题上训练 GOAL，并表明其表现仅略逊于专用基线，同时它是首个能够解决广泛 COP 的多任务模型。最后，我们通过在若干新问题上微调 GOAL，展示了其强大的迁移学习能力。代码见 https://github.com/naver/goal-co。

    Kun Gao, Katsumi Inoue, Yongzhi Cao, Hanpin Wang, Yang Feng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper combines self-supervised clustering with differentiable logic programming to learn generalized rules from raw sequences without explicit feature labels, a substantial contribution to learning reusable rules and representations. Rule induction has a partial connection to reasoning, while interpretability is a property of the learned model rather than an analysis of its internal mechanisms.

    本文将自监督聚类与可微逻辑编程结合起来，在没有显式特征标签的情况下从原始序列学习泛化规则，为学习可复用规则和表征作出了实质性贡献。规则归纳与推理有一定关联，而可解释性是所学模型的一项属性，并非对其内部机制的分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Rule learning-based models are widely used in highly interpretable scenarios due to their transparent structures. Inductive logic programming (ILP), a form of machine learning, induces rules from facts while maintaining interpretability. Differentiable ILP models enhance this process by leveraging neural networks to improve robustness and scalability. However, most differentiable ILP methods rely on symbolic datasets, facing challenges when learning directly from raw data. Specifically, they struggle with explicit label leakage: The inability to map continuous inputs to symbolic variables without explicit supervision of input feature labels. In this work, we address this issue by integrating a self-supervised differentiable clustering model with a novel differentiable ILP model, enabling rule learning from raw data without explicit label leakage. The learned rules effectively describe raw data through its features. We demonstrate that our method intuitively and precisely learns generalized rules from time series and image data.

    中文

    基于规则学习的模型因其结构透明，广泛用于对可解释性要求较高的场景。归纳逻辑编程（ILP）是一种机器学习方法，能够从事实中归纳规则，同时保持可解释性。可微 ILP 模型借助神经网络提高这一过程的稳健性和可扩展性。然而，大多数可微 ILP 方法依赖符号数据集，在直接从原始数据学习时面临挑战。具体而言，它们难以解决显式标签泄漏问题：在没有对输入特征标签进行明确监督的情况下，无法将连续输入映射到符号变量。在这项工作中，我们将自监督可微聚类模型与一种新颖的可微 ILP 模型相结合，解决了这一问题，从而能够在没有显式标签泄漏的情况下从原始数据学习规则。学到的规则能够有效地通过特征描述原始数据。我们证明，该方法能够直观且准确地从时间序列和图像数据中学习泛化规则。

    Intervening Anchor Token: Decoding Strategy in Alleviating Hallucinations for MLLMs

    干预锚点词元：缓解 MLLM 幻觉的解码策略

    Feilong Tang, Zile Huang, Chengzhi Liu, Qiang Sun, Harry Yang, Ser-Nam Lim

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how attention eigenvalue variance drives anchor-token propagation and visual hallucinations, then uses that analysis to motivate TAME, a decoding intervention. This offers substantial mechanistic insight into model behavior; hallucination reduction is relevant to reasoning only indirectly, and the decoding strategy alone provides limited systems contribution.

    本文分析了注意力特征值方差如何导致锚点词元传播和视觉幻觉，并以该分析为 TAME 这一解码干预方法提供依据。这为理解模型行为提供了重要的机制性见解；减少幻觉与推理只有间接关联，而解码策略本身对系统的贡献有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a powerful mechanism for interpreting visual information. However, they often suffer from hallucinations, which impede the real-world usage of these models. Existing methods attempt to alleviate this issue by designing special decoding strategies that penalize the summary tokens. However, these methods lack analysis of the relationship between hallucination and summarization mechanism of LLMs. Interestingly, we find that penalizing summary tokens is not necessary: merely intervening the query-key parameters variance, without costing extra inference time, still alleviates hallucinations. Specifically, we explore the causes of hallucinations by analyzing localized self-attention patterns called ``anchor" tokens and define the attention localization degree of the model as token propagation probabilities. Our analysis reveals that over-propagation of anchor tokens occurs when the distribution of eigenvalues of the query and key matrices has a non-zero mean and a polarized variance, leading to excessive dependence on anchor tokens while neglecting vision information and describes the image content with hallucination. Based on the observation, we propose a versatile plug-and-play decoding strategy, Dynamic Token Propagation Mechanism (TAME), to alleviate excessive propagation by dynamically intervening the eigenspectrum variance of the attention weight, thereby alleviating hallucinations without relying on complex decoding strategies. Extensive experiments reveal a correlation between the eigenspectrum and hallucinations across various MLLMs, and show that TAME reduces the percentage of hallucinated objects.

    中文

    多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）提供了一种强大的视觉信息解读机制。然而，它们常出现幻觉，妨碍了这些模型在现实世界中的应用。现有方法试图设计特殊解码策略，对摘要词元施加惩罚以缓解这一问题。但这些方法没有分析幻觉与 LLM 摘要机制之间的关系。有趣的是，我们发现，惩罚摘要词元并非必要：仅干预查询键参数的方差，即使不增加推理耗时，也能缓解幻觉。具体而言，我们通过分析称为“锚点”词元的局部自注意力模式来探究幻觉成因，并将模型的注意力局部化程度定义为词元传播概率。我们的分析发现，当查询矩阵和键矩阵的特征值分布具有非零均值和极化方差时，锚点词元会过度传播，从而导致模型过度依赖锚点词元、忽略视觉信息，并以幻觉方式描述图像内容。基于这一观察，我们提出一种通用的即插即用解码策略——动态词元传播机制（TAME），通过动态干预注意力权重的特征谱方差，缓解过度传播，从而无需依赖复杂解码策略即可缓解幻觉。广泛实验揭示了多种 MLLM 中特征谱与幻觉之间的相关性，并表明 TAME 能够降低幻觉物体的比例。

    Feature Averaging: An Implicit Bias of Gradient Descent Leading to Non-Robustness in Neural Networks

    特征平均：梯度下降的一种隐式偏置及其导致神经网络非鲁棒性

    Binghui Li, Zhixuan Pan, Kaifeng Lyu, Jian Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper theoretically and empirically studies how gradient descent combines distinct features into averaged representations, linking that mechanism to adversarial vulnerability and supervision. This provides substantial insight into feature learning, but does not center on compositional generalization, reasoning, or systems.

    本文从理论和实证角度研究梯度下降如何将不同特征组合成平均表征，并将这一机制与对抗脆弱性及监督方式联系起来。这为理解特征学习提供了重要见解，但重点并非组合泛化、推理或系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In this work, we investigate a particular implicit bias in gradient descent training, which we term “Feature Averaging,” and argue that it is one of the principal factors contributing to the non-robustness of deep neural networks. We show that, even when multiple discriminative features are present in the input data, neural networks trained by gradient descent tend to rely on an average (or a certain combination) of these features for classification, rather than distinguishing and leveraging each feature individually. Specifically, we provide a detailed theoretical analysis of the training dynamics of two-layer ReLU networks on a binary classification task, where the data distribution consists of multiple clusters with mutually orthogonal centers. We rigorously prove that gradient descent biases the network towards feature averaging, where the weights of each hidden neuron represent an average of the cluster centers (each corresponding to a distinct feature), thereby making the network vulnerable to input perturbations aligned with the negative direction of the averaged features. On the positive side, we demonstrate that this vulnerability can be mitigated through more granular supervision. In particular, we prove that a two-layer ReLU network can achieve optimal robustness when trained to classify individual features rather than merely the original binary classes. Finally, we validate our theoretical findings with experiments on synthetic datasets, MNIST, and CIFAR-10, and confirm the prevalence of feature averaging and its impact on adversarial robustness. We hope these theoretical and empirical insights deepen the understanding of how gradient descent shapes feature learning and adversarial robustness, and how more detailed supervision can enhance robustness.

    中文

    在本文中，我们研究梯度下降训练中的一种特定隐式偏置，并将其称为“特征平均”（Feature Averaging）；我们认为，这是导致深度神经网络非鲁棒性的主要因素之一。我们表明，即使输入数据中存在多个判别性特征，通过梯度下降训练的神经网络也倾向于依赖这些特征的平均值（或某种组合）进行分类，而不是分别区分并利用每个特征。具体而言，我们对二分类任务中双层 ReLU 网络的训练动态进行了详细的理论分析，其中数据分布由多个中心彼此正交的簇构成。我们严格证明，梯度下降会使网络偏向特征平均：每个隐藏神经元的权重都表示各簇中心（每个中心对应一种不同特征）的平均值，因此网络容易受到沿平均特征负方向的输入扰动影响。另一方面，我们证明，这种脆弱性可以通过更细粒度的监督来缓解。具体来说，我们证明，与仅对原始二元类别进行分类相比，训练双层 ReLU 网络对单个特征进行分类时，可以实现最优鲁棒性。最后，我们在合成数据集、MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上进行了实验，验证了理论发现，并确认了特征平均现象的普遍性及其对对抗鲁棒性的影响。我们希望这些理论和实证见解能加深人们对梯度下降如何塑造特征学习和对抗鲁棒性，以及更细致的监督如何提升鲁棒性的理解。

    Semantic Temporal Abstraction via Vision-Language Model Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning

    通过视觉语言模型引导的语义时间抽象，实现高效强化学习

    Tian-Shuo Liu, Xu-Hui Liu, Ruifeng Chen, Lixuan Jin, Pengyuan Wang, Zhilong Zhang, Yang Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VanTA uses VLM guidance to discover semantically meaningful temporal skills for offline reinforcement learning, with a theoretical account linking stronger within-skill correlations to reduced policy suboptimality. It substantially advances skill composition and long-horizon reasoning, while its VLM guidance does not investigate the model’s internal mechanisms.

    VanTA 利用 VLM 引导发现具有语义意义的时间技能，并从理论上说明技能内部更强的相关性如何降低策略次优性。它显著推进了技能组合和长时程推理；不过，其 VLM 引导并未研究模型的内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Extracting temporally extended skills can significantly improve the efficiency of reinforcement learning (RL) by breaking down complex decision-making problems with sparse rewards into simpler subtasks and enabling more effective credit assignment. However, existing abstraction methods either discover skills in an unsupervised manner, which often lacks semantic information and leads to erroneous or scattered skill extraction results, or require substantial human intervention. In this work, we propose to leverage the extensive knowledge in pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to progressively guide the latent space after vector quantization to be more semantically meaningful through relabeling each skill. This approach, termed **V**ision-l**an**guage model guided **T**emporal **A**bstraction (**VanTA**), facilitates the discovery of more interpretable and task-relevant temporal segmentations from offline data without the need for extensive manual intervention or heuristics. By leveraging the rich information in VLMs, our method can significantly outperform existing offline RL approaches that depend only on limited training data. From a theory perspective, we demonstrate that stronger internal sequential correlations within each sub-task, induced by VanTA, effectively reduces suboptimality in policy learning. We validate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments on diverse environments, including Franka Kitchen, Minigrid, and Crafter. These experiments show that our method surpasses existing approaches in long-horizon offline reinforcement learning scenarios with both proprioceptive and visual observations.

    中文

    提取跨越较长时间的技能，可以将稀疏奖励下的复杂决策问题拆解为更简单的子任务，并实现更有效的信用分配，从而显著提升强化学习（RL）的效率。然而，现有抽象方法要么以无监督方式发现技能，往往缺乏语义信息，导致提取出的技能有误或分散；要么需要大量人工干预。在本文中，我们提出利用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）中丰富的知识，通过为每项技能重新标注，逐步引导向量量化后的潜在空间，使其具有更丰富的语义。我们将这一方法称为视觉语言模型引导的时间抽象（**V**ision-l**an**guage model guided **T**emporal **A**bstraction，**VanTA**）。它能够从离线数据中发现更易解释且与任务相关的时间分段，无需大量人工干预或启发式规则。借助 VLM 中丰富的信息，我们的方法能够显著优于仅依赖有限训练数据的现有离线 RL 方法。从理论角度来看，我们证明，VanTA 所促成的各子任务内部更强的序列相关性，能够有效降低策略学习中的次优性。我们在多个不同环境中进行了大量实验，包括 Franka Kitchen、Minigrid 和 Crafter，以验证该方法的有效性。实验表明，在同时使用本体感知和视觉观测的长时程离线强化学习场景中，我们的方法优于现有方法。

    h4rm3l: A Language for Composable Jailbreak Attack Synthesis

    h4rm3l：一种用于合成可组合越狱攻击的语言

    Moussa Koulako Bala Doumbouya, Ananjan Nandi, Gabriel Poesia, Davide Ghilardi, Anna Goldie, Federico Bianchi, Dan Jurafsky, Christopher D Manning

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a DSL for composing jailbreak transformations and a bandit-based synthesizer that explores combinations to red-team LLMs, making compositional attack synthesis a substantial algorithmic contribution. The LLM safety-evaluation context does not provide insight into internal mechanisms or reasoning, and the toolkit's use of models alone is incidental to systems research.

    本文提出一种用于组合越狱转换的 DSL，以及一个基于多臂老虎机的合成器，通过探索不同组合对 LLM 进行红队测试，使组合式攻击合成成为一项重要的算法贡献。LLM 安全评估这一背景并未揭示模型的内部机制或推理；工具包仅使用模型这一点也与系统研究没有实质关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Despite their demonstrated valuable capabilities, state-of-the-art (SOTA) widely deployed large language models (LLMs) still have the potential to cause harm to society due to the ineffectiveness of their safety filters, which can be bypassed by prompt transformations called jailbreak attacks. Current approaches to LLM safety assessment, which employ datasets of templated prompts and benchmarking pipelines, fail to cover sufficiently large and diverse sets of jailbreak attacks, leading to the widespread deployment of unsafe LLMs. Recent research showed that novel jailbreak attacks could be derived by composition; however, a formal composable representation for jailbreak attacks, which, among other benefits, could enable the exploration of a large compositional space of jailbreak attacks through program synthesis methods, has not been previously proposed. We introduce h4rm3l, a novel approach that addresses this gap with a human-readable domain-specific language (DSL). Our framework comprises: (1) The h4rm3l DSL, which formally expresses jailbreak attacks as compositions of parameterized string transformation primitives. (2) A synthesizer with bandit algorithms that efficiently generates jailbreak attacks optimized for a target black box LLM. (3) The h4rm3l red-teaming software toolkit that employs the previous two components and an automated harmful LLM behavior classifier that is strongly aligned with human judgment. We demonstrate h4rm3l's efficacy by synthesizing a dataset of 2656 successful novel jailbreak attacks targeting 6 SOTA open-source and proprietary LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4o, Claude-3-Sonnet, Claude-3-Haiku, Llama-3-8B, and Llama-3-70B), and by benchmarking those models against a subset of these synthesized attacks. Our results show that h4rm3l's synthesized attacks are diverse and more successful than existing jailbreak attacks in literature, with success rates exceeding 90% on SOTA LLMs. Warning: This paper and related research artifacts contain offensive and potentially disturbing prompts and model-generated content.

    中文

    尽管当前最先进（SOTA）且广泛部署的大型语言模型（LLM）展现出有价值的能力，但由于安全过滤器效果不佳，它们仍可能危害社会；这些过滤器可以被称为越狱攻击的提示转换绕过。当前的 LLM 安全评估方法采用模板化提示数据集和基准测试流程，未能覆盖足够大且多样的越狱攻击集合，导致不安全的 LLM 被广泛部署。近期研究表明，可以通过组合得到新型越狱攻击；然而，此前尚未提出越狱攻击的形式化可组合表示，而这种表示的诸多用途之一，是能够通过程序合成方法探索庞大的越狱攻击组合空间。我们提出 h4rm3l，以一种新方法填补这一空白，它提供了人类可读的领域专用语言（DSL）。我们的框架包含：(1) h4rm3l DSL，用于将越狱攻击形式化表示为参数化字符串转换基本操作的组合；(2) 一个结合了多臂老虎机算法的合成器，能够高效生成针对目标黑盒 LLM 优化的越狱攻击；(3) h4rm3l 红队软件工具包，它使用前述两个组件，并配有一个与人类判断高度一致的自动化有害 LLM 行为分类器。我们通过合成一个包含 2656 个成功新型越狱攻击的数据集，证明了 h4rm3l 的有效性；这些攻击针对 6 个最先进的开源和专有 LLM（GPT-3.5、GPT-4o、Claude-3-Sonnet、Claude-3-Haiku、Llama-3-8B 和 Llama-3-70B）。我们还用这些合成攻击中的一部分对上述模型进行了基准测试。结果表明，h4rm3l 合成的攻击具有多样性，且比文献中已有的越狱攻击更成功，在最先进的 LLM 上成功率超过 90%。警告：本文及相关研究材料包含冒犯性且可能令人不安的提示和模型生成内容。

    Lines of Thought in Large Language Models

    大型语言模型中的思维轨迹

    Raphaël Sarfati, Toni J.B. Liu, Nicolas Boulle, Christopher Earls

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes transformer computation as trajectories through embedding space, finding a low-dimensional non-Euclidean manifold and a compact stochastic approximation. This offers substantial insight into representation geometry, while its connection to reasoning is limited to interpreting trajectories as contextualization or “thinking” steps, without studying reasoning capabilities or mechanisms directly.

    本文将 Transformer 计算刻画为嵌入空间中的轨迹，发现这些轨迹位于低维非欧几里得流形上，并可用紧凑的随机模型近似。这为理解表征几何提供了重要见解；其与推理的联系仅限于将轨迹解释为上下文化或“思考”步骤，并未直接研究推理能力或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models achieve next-token prediction by transporting a vectorized piece of text (prompt) across an accompanying embedding space under the action of successive transformer layers. The resulting high-dimensional trajectories realize different contextualization, or 'thinking', steps, and fully determine the output probability distribution. We aim to characterize the statistical properties of ensembles of these 'lines of thought.' We observe that independent trajectories cluster along a low-dimensional, non-Euclidean manifold, and that their path can be well approximated by a stochastic equation with few parameters extracted from data. We find it remarkable that the vast complexity of such large models can be reduced to a much simpler form, and we reflect on implications.

    中文

    大型语言模型通过在连续 Transformer 层的作用下，将向量化的文本片段（提示）传输至相应的嵌入空间，实现下一个 token 的预测。由此产生的高维轨迹体现了不同的上下文化或“思考”步骤，并完全决定输出概率分布。我们的目标是刻画这些“思维轨迹”集合的统计特性。我们观察到，独立轨迹聚集在一个低维、非欧几里得流形上，而且其路径可以用一个参数很少、从数据中提取的随机方程很好地近似。我们认为，大型模型的庞大复杂性能够化约为一种简单得多的形式，这一点非常引人注目；我们也探讨了其启示。
